摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Neighborhood-based rough graphs: theory and applications

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11426-4 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The integration of rough set theory with graph theory provides a robust framework for modeling uncertainty in relational networks. However, existing rough graph models face critical limitations: they either rely on restrictive equivalence relations or treat vertex and edge sets as independent domains. This disconnect ignores intrinsic topological dependencies, often producing mathematically definable but topologically invalid approximations, such as edges appearing without valid endpoints. To address these issues, this paper introduces a comprehensive framework for neighborhood-based rough graphs grounded in the principle of structural induction. We propose three distinct but complementary models: (1) Vertex-Based Rough Graphs, which use vertex relations to naturally induce edge neighborhoods; (2) Edge-Based Rough Graphs, which use edge relations to trigger necessary vertex expansions; and (3) Generalized Rough Graphs, which unify both approaches to ensure rigorous topological consistency under arbitrary binary relations. We conduct a rigorous theoretical analysis, proving that these induced operators guarantee unconditional subgraph validity, satisfy key algebraic properties, and align with Kuratowski closure-complement axioms. Finally, through comparative theoretical analysis in protein interaction and social networks, coupled with a quantitative application to a real-world academic collaboration network, we demonstrate how the proposed framework effectively resolves the structural validity and false-positive issues inherent in prior models. Specifically, our quantitative results confirm that the generalized model successfully restrains structural hallucination and guarantees computable accuracy metrics, overcoming the topological failures of classical independent models.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

On line upper ideal relation graphs of rings

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11467-9 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The upper ideal relation graph Γ_U(R) of a commutative ring R with unity is a simple undirected graph with the set of all non-unit elements of R as a vertex set and two vertices x, y are adjacent if and only if the principal ideals (x) and (y) are contained in the principal ideal (z) for some non-unit element z∈R. Baloda et al. (Upper ideal relation graphs associated to rings. Soft Comput 28:10815–10826, 2024) have classified all non-local commutative rings such that Γ_U(R) having genus (or crosscap) at most 2. In this manuscript, we continue the study of upper ideal relation graph Γ_U(R). In this connection, we consider the problem of line graph characterization of Γ_U(R) for Artinian rings. This manuscript characterizes all the Artinian rings R such that the graph Γ_U(R) is a line graph. Moreover, all the Artinian rings R for which Γ_U(R) is the complement of a line graph have been described.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Topological and approximation structures induced by fuzzy betweenness relations

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11444-2 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper introduces a novel fuzzy topological approximation framework induced by fuzzy betweenness relations to address key limitations in existing fuzzy rough and covering-based models, particularly the lack of structural consistency between lower and upper approximations. Unlike traditional approaches based on binary relations, the proposed framework employs ternary fuzzy betweenness relations to enhance expressive power and modeling flexibility. Four types of fuzzy betweenness neighborhood systems—right, left, intersection, and union—are defined and used to construct corresponding k-fuzzy betweenness topological spaces. Based on these spaces, four fuzzy betweenness topological approximation models are developed, providing a unified mechanism for approximating fuzzy sets while preserving the inclusion relationship between lower and upper approximations. Theoretical analysis establishes the fundamental properties and interrelationships among the models, while accuracy measures enable quantitative comparison of their performance. In particular, the intersection-based model achieves the highest approximation accuracy, indicating improved decision reliability. The proposed framework offers a structurally consistent and more expressive extension of existing models for uncertainty modeling and decision-making applications.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A homomorphic hash-based multi-replica data integrity verification scheme for edge computing

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11578-3 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Edge computing enables service providers to deploy services on distributed edge servers, minimizing clients’ data retrieval delays. However, such edge data is susceptible to intentional or accidental corruption in a highly distributed and dynamic edge computing environment. Therefore, we propose a multi-replica integrity scheme deployed in the cloud-edge collaboration framework. The scheme employs a homomorphic hash function to achieve blockless verification and nonlinear resource scaling as file sizes increase. The client uses a pseudo-random function to generate replica mask vectors, enabling the user to recover corrupted data blocks while preserving confidentiality for both the cloud server and edge servers. The cloud server aggregates the proofs generated from edge data replicas for verification, effectively reducing computational overhead. Under the random oracle model, our scheme has been proven to be unforgeable under the computational Diffie-Hellman problem. To evaluate its performance, we simulated this solution and conducted many experiments. Experimental results show that the proposed model performs better and is more suitable for edge computing.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Dynamic stability enhancement in hybrid AC/DC microgrids using TDO-CANN approach under external disturbances

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11447-z · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Comparing microgrids to conventional power grids reveals several technological, environmental, and financial advantages. However, there are a number of issues with microgrid operation, including load fluctuations and intermittent renewable energy sources (RESs). A hybrid strategy for enhancing dynamic stability in hybrid AC/DC microgrids against outside disturbances is presented in this publication. The proposed method combines the Tasmanian Devil Optimization (TDO) and Constitutive Artificial Neural Networks (CANN), which is termed the TDO-CANN method. The primary objective of the proposed technique is to reduce the impact of variations in renewable power generation, improve stability, and ensure robustness against load demand changes in microgrids. The dynamic elements of the hybrid AC/DC microgrid are modeled by considering the effects of load disturbance, renewable intermittency, grid faults, and measurement noise. The TDO algorithm is employed to optimize the control parameters of the hybrid AC/DC microgrid system. The CANN is utilized to predict the optimal performance of the AC/DC microgrid. The proposed method is evaluated and compared to other existing methods on the MATLAB platform. The proposed technique displays better outcomes in all existing like Ant Lion Optimizer (ALO), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA). The proposed method achieves a mean percentage voltage tracking error of 0.04% with an execution time of 2.15 s. Statistical analysis confirms the superiority of the approach with a p-value <0.001, indicating significant improvement over existing methods. Furthermore, under measurement noise levels of 1%, 3%, and 5%, the proposed method consistently demonstrates superior robustness and lower error compared to benchmark techniques. These results confirm that the proposed TDO-CANN framework provides enhanced stability, faster convergence, and improved robustness for hybrid AC/DC microgrids under dynamic and uncertain conditions.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Sequential and Decoupled Reliability Analysis applied to time-dependent engineering systems

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11486-6 · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Traditionally, reliability analysis neglects the influence of time, leading to inaccurate predictions for systems under progressive degradation and variable loads. However, addressing time dependency is of major significance, as material aging and cumulative damage dynamically alter the system’s condition, increasing the probability of failure throughout its operational lifespan. Time-dependent (or time-variant) reliability analysis addresses this challenge, as time directly affects failure probability. This paper proposes and evaluates two methodologies: Sequential Reliability Analysis (SRA) and Decoupled Reliability Analysis (DRA). SRA transforms the time-dependent problem into an equivalent time-independent one by discretizing time, using a metamodel to approximate the failure probability profile, and performing a one-dimensional search for the optimal value. In this method, reliability analysis is required at each discretized time point. Conversely, DRA also removes time dependency but does so by replacing the time variable with a metamodel dependent on random variables, requiring only one reliability analysis. Both methodologies were validated through mathematical and engineering case studies. The results demonstrate that both provide accurate failure probability estimates, with errors below 2% when compared to reference solutions or Monte Carlo Method (MCM) results. Additionally, the DRA approach achieved a computational cost reduction of up to 99.8% relative to the traditional method. These findings confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed approaches for time-dependent reliability analysis in engineering applications.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Knowledge representation and approximation operator of interval neutrosophic fuzzy semiconcept

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11531-4 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

In the interval neutrosophic fuzzy formal context, the existing interval neutrosophic fuzzy concept is extended to be the interval neutrosophic fuzzy semiconcept in order to extract more valuable information. Compared existing three-way fuzzy concept representation using neutrosophic set method of extracting information, the expression of membership degree is extended from a single value to the interval. As a result, it gives a choice range for a decision-maker. Furthermore, it strengthens the objectivity of fuzzy information so that the final decision result made by the decision maker is more reliable. Combined the interval neutrosophic set and the classical semiconcept, we propose object-oriented interval neutrosophic fuzzy semiconcept and attribute-oriented interval neutrosophic fuzzy semiconcept, respectively. Based on the above two new semiconcepts, the two pairs of upper and lower approximation operators are provided for the object-oriented interval neutrosophic fuzzy semiconcept and the attribute-oriented interval neutrosophic fuzzy semiconcept, respectively. All of the undefinable knowledge in the interval neutrosophic fuzzy formal context is explored with one of the two new semiconcepts as definable knowledge with the help of the corresponding approximation operators.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

QSMOTE-PGM/KPGM: quantum machine learning inspired model for QSMOTE with PGM and kPGM classifiers for imbalanced dataset classification

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11441-5 · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Quantum-inspired machine learning (QiML) employs mathematical principles from quantum theory, such as Hilbert-space representations and quantum state discrimination, to enhance classical learning algorithms. In this work, we investigate the integration of Quantum Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (QSMOTE) variants with two quantum-inspired classifiers: the Pretty Good Measurement (PGM) classifier and the kernelized Pretty Good Measurement (KPGM) classifier. We propose and analyze three QSMOTE variants, namely KNN-based, Fidelity-based, and Margin-based QSMOTE, designed to improve minority-class representation in imbalanced datasets through quantum-inspired similarity and sampling mechanisms. A unified theoretical and empirical comparison of PGM and KPGM is presented under amplitude and stereo encoding strategies with multiple quantum copies. Experimental evaluations on the Telco Customer Churn dataset demonstrate that the proposed quantum-inspired approaches consistently outperform a classical Random Forest baseline, particularly in terms of recall and balanced F1-score. Among all configurations, PGM with stereo encoding and n_(copies)=2 n copies = 2 achieves the best performance with an accuracy of 0.8512 and an F1-score of 0.8234, while KPGM exhibits competitive and more stable behavior across different QSMOTE variants, reaching accuracies of 0.8511 under stereo encoding and 0.8483 under amplitude encoding. The results further show that increasing the number of quantum copies systematically improves classification performance, especially for minority-class detection. This work highlights the effectiveness of combining quantum-inspired oversampling and classification strategies for imbalanced learning, while providing practical insights into the complementary strengths of measurement-based and kernel-based quantum-inspired machine learning frameworks.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

REGAN: evolutionary adversarial training with generative regularization in machine learning models for high-fidelity image synthesis

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11448-y · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) demonstrate remarkable success in producing realistic images for various applications. This work proposes a new REGAN framework that integrates evolutionary adversarial training with generative regularization. REGAN gains complex manifold representation capabilities from traditional GANs through reconstruction-based losses, achieving decreased susceptibility to mode collapse. The proposed model is evaluated on four datasets of increasing complexity: MNIST, CelebA, BreCaHAD, and AFHQ, as well as on standard inverse problems, including deconvolution, compressed sensing, and out-of-distribution testing. Experimental results demonstrate that REGAN is capable of generating realistic samples and performing meaningful latent interpolation, while achieving strong reconstruction performance. Furthermore, the proposed REGAN can substantially improve the performance of generative models, illustrating that data-driven priors can provide significant improvements over adversarial or variational approaches.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Simultaneous unsupervised feature selection with adaptive loss constraint and discrete binary hashing for clustering

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11450-4 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

As an important analysis technique of machine learning, clustering has received extensive attention. However, the following problems still exist. First, facing the massive multimedia data, how to effectively process these data and perform effective image clustering is a hot issue. Second, in the traditional clustering method, the clustering is carried out in the data space. When performing clustering tasks in the data space, high-dimensional data can make clustering slow. Recent studies have shown that hashing can achieve efficient clustering. In order to obtain better clustering results, a new binary clustering framework. Simultaneous Unsupervised Feature Selection with Adaptive Loss Constraint and Discrete Binary Hashing for Clustering (ALDBC) is proposed. This method is based on an adaptive loss function to achieve data dimensional reduction and low-rank clustering in Hamming space, which is integrated into a single framework for mutual guidance and dynamic improvement. More specifically, the framework uses an adaptive loss optimization algorithm, which is located between the ℓ ₁-norm and the ℓ ₂-norm, combining the advantages of the two to enhance the robustness of outliers and reduce the dimension of high-dimensional data at the same time. Then, the sparse binary matrices are decomposed into low-rank matrices in Hamming space to complete image clustering. Finally, the objective function can rapidly converge with the optimization scheme. Experimental results on data sets show that this method can effectively improve the efficiency of clustering. Compared to the state-of-the-art methods, the time efficiency of ALDBC was improved when processing high-dimensional data.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

MFANet: a lightweight multi-feature attention network for medical image classification

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11461-1 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Despite remarkable advances in deep convolutional neural networks, most state-of-the-art architectures are over-parameterized for medical image classification tasks, often hindering deployment in resource-constrained environments, limiting their real-world practicality. To address these challenges, we propose a lightweight Multi-Feature Attention Network (MFANet) that is explicitly designed to balance accuracy, efficiency, and effective feature utilization for medical imaging applications. MFANet integrates a multi-branch feature extraction module with varying filter capacities to capture complementary feature representations, followed by channel and spatial attention mechanisms to enhance salient diagnostic cues while suppressing irrelevant information. A cross-scale interaction attention module further promotes selective information exchange across feature branches, and a multi-head cross-attention classifier strengthens discriminative learning through structured feature fusion. Extensive experiments on three benchmark medical image datasets demonstrate that MFANet consistently outperforms competitive baselines while maintaining reduced computational complexity and parameter count. On ISIC-2018, MFANet achieves a minimum accuracy improvement of 1.28%, while delivering gains of 0.11% on the SIPaKMeD dataset and 0.57% and 0.49% on BreakHis at 40× and 100× magnifications, respectively. These results highlight MFANet as an effective and computationally efficient alternative to conventional deep architectures, offering a practical solution for real-world medical image classification under constrained resource settings.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Hybrid harmony search and artificial neural network framework for optimal design of composite steel column cross-sections

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11417-5 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Composite steel columns, which integrate structural steel sections with reinforced concrete, are essential load-bearing elements in modern high-rise and industrial structures. Their optimal design presents a formidable computational challenge due to the highly non-convex, multimodal design space arising from material nonlinearity, geometric imperfections, and complex code-based interaction constraints. Conventional gradient-based optimisation methods frequently fail to locate global optima in such problems, motivating the development of advanced metaheuristic approaches. This paper presents the Hybrid Harmony Search–Artificial Neural Network (HHSA) framework, a novel computational system that integrates the Harmony Search (HS) metaheuristic algorithm with a pre-trained deep feedforward Artificial Neural Network (ANN) surrogate model for the optimal design of composite steel column cross-sections subjected to combined axial and biaxial bending loads. The key novelty of the proposed approach lies in the synergistic coupling of HS global search capability with an ANN surrogate that replaces costly finite-element evaluations during the optimisation loop, combined with a periodic retraining mechanism that anchors the surrogate to high-fidelity data, thereby preventing surrogate drift while reducing computational burden by up to 73% relative to direct finite-element evaluation. The optimisation problem is formulated to minimise total material weight subject to comprehensive strength, stability, and ductility constraints derived from both AISC 360–22 and Eurocode 4—the first study to enforce dual-code compliance simultaneously in composite column optimisation. Three benchmark case studies—a short concentrically loaded column, a slender eccentrically loaded column, and a multi-storey frame column under seismic loading—are solved. Results demonstrate that HHSA consistently converges to lighter designs compared with standard HS (8.3–14.7% weight reduction), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Particle Swarm Optimisation (PSO), while achieving a 68% reduction in average computation time. The surrogate model attains a coefficient of determination R² = 0.9987 on the test set, confirming its high fidelity. However, the current framework is limited to prismatic column cross-sections with predefined topologies and does not account for time-dependent effects such as concrete creep and shrinkage. The proposed framework offers a robust, code-compliant, and computationally efficient tool for practical composite column design, with significant implications for reducing material consumption in high-rise construction.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Leader-guided multi-agent metaheuristic for balanced exploration and exploitation

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11480-y · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Most metaheuristic algorithms struggle to balance exploration and exploitation, often becoming inefficient or converging prematurely to local optima. To address this issue, this article introduces a novel metaheuristic algorithm based on a multi-agent systems that achieves a better balance between exploration and exploitation. The population is first initialized using the GIBBS initialization method, ensuring efficient and well-distributed coverage of the search space. The search then alternates between two phases: in the first phase, a randomly selected leader from a subset of high-quality guides the population by applying a transformation that moves it coherently toward the global best solution, promoting coordinated movement while maintaining structural coherence within the population. In the second phase, agents update their positions based on a better neighboring agent, maintaining diversity and preventing premature convergence. This dual mechanism effectively combines strong exploitation with controlled exploration. The algorithm’s performance was validated on 30 benchmark functions, showing superior convergence, solution quality, and robustness compared to other established metaheuristic methods in the literature.

论文题名

Applicability of a quantum-inspired genetic algorithm to patient scheduling in radiation oncology

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11449-x · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Among the genetic algorithms generally used for optimization problems in the recent decades, quantum-inspired variants are known for fast and high-fitness convergence and small resource requirement. Here the application to the patient scheduling problem in proton therapy is reported. Quantum-inspired chromosomes are tailored to possess the superposed data of patient IDs and gantry statuses. Selection and repair strategies are also elaborated for reliable convergence to a clinically feasible schedule although the employed model is not complex. Clear advantage in population size is shown over the classical counterpart in our numerical results for both a medium-size test case and a large-size practical problem instance. It is, however, observed that program run time is rather long for the large-size practical case, which is due to the limitation of classical emulation and demands the forthcoming true quantum computation. Our results also revalidate the stability of the conventional classical genetic algorithm.

A novel modiffication of discrete gradient method for non-smooth optimization

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11469-7 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper introduces an innovative approach aimed at tackling unconstrained non-smooth optimization problems by introducing a modified discrete gradient method. Through the incorporation of the discrete gradient concept, our method effectively minimizes the need for evaluations and computational time, ultimately resulting in enhanced efficiency and performance. We establish the convergence of this adapted discrete gradient method for semi-smooth objective functions, even in cases where differentiability or convexity may not be guaranteed. Additionally, our numerical results serve to validate the effectiveness of our approach, providing substantial evidence of its efficiency in optimizing complex problem sets.

论文题名

Development of a multi-stage Fermatean fuzzy decision support system for assessing solar power plant locations under uncertain conditions

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11439-z · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Solar energy is gaining prominence as a renewable energy source due to its abundance and eco-friendliness. However, the recent increasing interest raises concerns about the sustainability of solar energy investments. Therefore, it is imperative to strategically choose an investment location problem, considering various criteria that encompass social, economic, and technical aspects. This study advocates an innovative and decision-centric approach, employing an integrated multi-stage Fermatean fuzzy-based multi-criteria decision-making methodology for the solution of this problem. The methodology systematically determines the importance weights of the criteria and prioritizes alternative sites to identify the optimal location for investments in solar power plant construction. In the initial stage, the focus lies on selecting the most suitable region for the installation of solar power plants. Subsequently, the second stage involves identifying the most appropriate location within the chosen region. Applied to the Türkiye case, the methodology designates the “Eastern Anatolia Region” as the most suitable region and identifies “Bingöl-Karlıova” as the most appropriate location. Sensitivity and comparative analyses validate the robustness of the decisions and verify the results. This paper significantly contributes to the existing literature by demonstrating the applied methodology, combining knowledge and experience from current market characteristics and engineering fields to improve the assessment process, providing human-centered design insights, and accelerating the development of renewable energy investments. 摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A novel multiple attribute decision making technique based on Dombi extended power average operator under picture hesitant fuzzy environment

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-025-10777-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Picture hesitant fuzzy set (PHFS) can better depict complicated uncertainty information in multiple attribute decision making (MADM). However, there are some limitations concerning aggregation operators (AOs) and operational laws of picture hesitant fuzzy numbers (PHFNs). Thus, a novel MADM technique, which considers the advantages of extended power average (EPA) operator and Dombi operations, is proposed. Firstly, the distance measure and Dombi operations are defined. Secondly, to handle extreme data more rationally, the EPA operator is generalized to PHFNs. Two new operators, namely, the picture hesitant fuzzy Dombi extended power average (PHFDEPA) operator and the picture hesitant fuzzy Dombi extended power weighted average (PHFDEPWA) operator, are established, and some special cases are also discussed. Thirdly, a picture hesitant fuzzy MADM model employing the proposed operator is built. Eventually, to verify the feasibility and superiority of this technique, an example is applied. Additionally, the susceptibility and contrastive analyses are also conducted.

论文题名

Forecasting futures settlement returns with LSTM for options trading strategies

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11550-1 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Algorithmic trading has traditionally centered on investment portfolios and asset pricing research, largely overlooking the potential of options in trading strategies. However, options present unique advantages as financial instruments, offering risk management and strategic opportunities based on market trends. This paper introduces a novel approach for options trading by integrating long short-term memory (LSTM) and Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) with the options spread strategy to estimate the expected value and achieve positive long-term returns. Leveraging different frequency prices as features and incorporating the Gate Recurrent Unit (GRU), the proposed method demonstrates its effectiveness in enhancing backtesting performance and filtering trading strategies based on expected values. Empirical research employing Taiwan Stock Futures (TXF) weekly options (TXOW) spanning January 2017 to December 2021. The approach demonstrated success, yielding a final payoff of 1,112,030 NTD, a profit factor of 5.67, and a profit-loss ratio of 2.20. This study highlights the potential of deep learning techniques in the domain of options trading and underscores the prospects for future advancements in this evolving field.

论文题名

Natural language processing via advanced recurrent neural networks for word isolated recognition to control a Mexican Sign Language tutoring virtual system

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-025-10981-6 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Natural language processing (NLP) is the discipline of building systems and machines that can manipulate human language and how it is organized, written, and spoken. It can be divided into natural language understanding (NLU) and natural language generation (NLG). NLP is frequently used with automatic speech recognition (ASR), which seeks to map spoken words into language sequences, turning them into sound or text. An area of ASR is isolated word recognition (IWR) which is the process of converting a spoken word to text. The main contribution of this study is, Spanish IWR with a deep learning methodology (DL) classification based on two specialized recurrent neural network architectures: long short-term memories (LSTMs) and gated recurrent units (GRUs). A Spanish corpus of words was created, artificially augmented, and preprocessed. Wavelet scattering transform (WST) was chosen for feature extraction as it offers multiresolution analysis. Subsequently, the scattering coefficient matrices were the input to GRU and LSTM to compare their performance. Leave one-out group cross-validation (LOGOCV) and traditional test/training split method were implemented to validate both DL architectures. Applying the selected training and validation strategy yields 93% accuracy for the LSTM, whereas GRU resulted in 94% showing comparable performance on similar reported works. The recognized words were the input to control a virtual robotic hand composed of 25 DOF that executed finger-spelling in Mexican Sign Language (MSL). Therefore, this is an alternative education to teach finger-spelling in MSL based on direct spoken interaction with the virtual tutoring system. Efficient car theft detection using multi-model human detection and adaptive voting deep transfer learning methods

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11429-1 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Vehicle theft remains a significant security challenge that demands innovative, automated detection methods. This study introduces an advanced system that combines video analysis and deep learning to enhance the accuracy of theft prevention. The research offers three main contributions: first, creating a dedicated real-world vehicle theft dataset; second, implementing a Multi-Model Human Detection with a Maximal Intersection Strategy to identify Regions of Interest (ROI) precisely; and third, developing an Adaptive Voting Deep Transfer Learning architecture for reliable image classification. By overcoming the limitations of single-model detection in complex surveillance environments, this hybrid approach achieves a 99.48% accuracy. Evaluation results demonstrate that this method substantially surpasses traditional deep learning models, establishing a highly dependable tool for real-time security monitoring.

论文题名

A L1-CFD method for a time-fractional advection–diffusion equation with variable coefficients subjected to weakly singular solutions

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11428-2 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper presents a graded mesh scheme for approximating the solution of a Caputo temporal fractional advection diffusion model with variable coefficients subjected to weak singularity at t=0. The existence and uniqueness of the solution is investigated using the Sumudu decomposition technique and maximum–minimum principle. The temporal fractional derivative is discretized via the L1 scheme on a non-uniform mesh, while a fourth-order compact finite difference (CFD) scheme on a uniform mesh is employed for the discretization of spatial derivatives. The stability and convergence of the method are examined in the L_∞ norm. Several numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the scheme. A comparison between the graded and uniform mesh methods is provided, and the present approach is further compared with the method reported in Roul et al. (2023a) to highlight its advantages. Finally, an application of the model problem is also discussed to illustrate its practical relevance.

论文题名

Enhanced forensic face reconstruction: a conditional U-Net diffusion model approach

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11438-0 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Reconstructing realistic faces from forensic sketches is a critical challenge in computer vision, with significant implications for security and forensic applications. This paper introduces an advanced conditional U-Net diffusion model (cDDPM) designed to enhance the fidelity and accuracy of facial image reconstruction from sketches. By leveraging a gradual noise reduction process, the model preserves fine structural details more effectively than traditional methods. Using the CUHK dataset, our model achieved a Fréchet Inception Distance of 1.40, a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio of 34.15 dB, and a Structural Similarity Index of 99.68%, demonstrating superior performance over GAN models. The results show significant improvements in both perceptual quality and pixel-level resolution. We also provide a detailed discussion of the limitations of our approach, including the risk of over-processing of the CUHK, the high computational cost of inference, and the need for identity-specific evaluation metrics in future forensic validation studies.

论文题名

Fault proneness estimation of software modules using dependency-aware change metrics and machine learning

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11436-2 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

To evaluate software quality, measuring key factors such as reliability and fault incidence is essential. These factors, while necessary for improving software quality, can only be calculated during the later stages of the software development lifecycle, which limits the ability to address issues proactively. To overcome this limitation, fault prediction models use early-stage software metrics to estimate fault-prone modules. In this paper, we propose a novel metric, change-for-dependency (CFD), which accounts explicitly for the impact of changes in module dependencies, a factor often ignored by traditional fault prediction models. Our approach not only enhances fault prediction by considering the interdependencies between modules but also introduces a broader, generalizable framework for fault-prone module detection. To validate the effectiveness of CFD, we conducted experiments using the widely used PROMISE Eclipse dataset, demonstrating that the CFD metric significantly improves fault detection accuracy. The results show that CFD is ranked 18th out of 201 metrics in the PROMISE dataset, underscoring its superior predictive power. This work presents both a specific solution for fault prediction in the context of module dependencies and a generic method applicable to various software systems for enhancing overall software quality.

论文题名

An innovative approach to predict turbulent flow around a circular cylinder using Generative AI technology

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11442-4 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The prediction of turbulent flow around bluff bodies, such as circular cylinders, is a complex problem due to the nonlinear dynamics of vortex shedding and flow separation, which challenge conventional computational methods. This study presents an innovative application of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) to predict turbulent flow over a single circular cylinder. The GenAI model was trained using high-fidelity simulation data and successfully captured the major flow patterns, including vortex shedding and wake evolution. Comparative analysis against reference numerical simulations showed that the model performed strongly for fixed Reynolds-number cases, while reduced accuracy was observed for the varying-Reynolds-number case, indicating a limitation under non-stationary flow-regime transitions. Furthermore, stability and spatial–temporal frequency analyses showed strong agreement with reference simulations, particularly for the fixed-Re test groups. These results highlight the potential of the proposed GenAI framework as a promising surrogate model for turbulent flow prediction, while also clarifying the current boundary of its applicability.

论文题名

A hybrid ANN-BCGA model for the quality improvement of the perforated tubes in electromagnetic forming and perforation: data driven methodology and experimental validation

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11464-y · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper has proposed an information-oriented methodology to uncover nonlinear regulation in forming and perforation control, specifically in the context of an electromagnetic forming and perforation process. A coupled EM-structural model in Ls-Dyna™ software has been used to train the artificial neural networks (ANN) model. ANN have been employed to acquire the process mapping between four vital parameters: (discharge energy, tube thickness, number of punches, and standoff distance); and two important indices: perforation index (average hole diameter) and forming index (tube thickness reduction ratio). A genetic-algorithm-based multi-objective optimization has been used to maximize both average hole diameter and the tube thickness reduction ratio. The study has revealed two keys forming and perforation control rules to achieve desired outcomes: Firstly, a higher discharge energy is preferred for maximum forming and perforation. Secondly, a tube thickness of 1.2 mm Al-6061-T6 tubes is preferred without crack occurrence in the intermediate zone between two consecutive holes. The selection rules are relevant for both pointed and concave punch configurations. Experimental validations on the optimized parameters have shown highly satisfactory results, with maximum deviations of less than 3% for the average hole diameter and less than 5% for the tube thickness reduction ratio.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Weakly supervised temporal action localization in a video using phase correlation

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11477-7 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Current weakly-supervised temporal action localization (W-TAL) methods predominantly rely on I3D pretrained on the Kinetics dataset to extract RGB and optical flow features. This dependency introduces two limitations: 1) substantial computational cost during feature extraction and training, and 2) features optimized for action recognition may not be optimal for temporal localization. In this work, we investigate phase correlation computed via Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) as an alternative parameter-free motion feature for W-TAL. Phase correlation captures translational displacement between consecutive frames in the frequency domain without requiring pretrained networks. Using BaS-Net as our baseline for its established background suppression mechanism, we conduct a systematic comparison across multiple configurations to investigate whether phase correlation can serve as an alternative motion feature for W-TAL. Our results show that phase correlation features alone achieve near-zero mAP across all IoU thresholds on THUMOS14, while the I3D baseline achieves 26.22% mAP@0.5. Augmenting I3D features with four temporal phase statistics yields 26.17% mAP@0.5, showing no complementary benefit over I3D alone (26.22%). Ablation analysis reveals that the performance gap stems primarily from the feature representation–phase correlation encodes only coarse translational displacement and lacks the appearance and semantic information essential for class-discriminative temporal localization.

论文题名

A hybrid technique for effectiveness evaluation of university innovation and entrepreneurship education reform based on probabilistic linguistic group decision-making

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11524-3 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

With the deepening of educational reform, innovation and entrepreneurship education should receive significant attention. Teachers should promptly introduce more new knowledge and educational concepts to support innovation and entrepreneurship education in universities. This will enable students to acquire more knowledge through such education, greatly promoting their long-term development. The effectiveness evaluation of university innovation and entrepreneurship education reform is a multiple-attribute group decision-making (MAGDM) problem. Recently, the Exponential TODIM (ExpTODIM) and PROMETHEE technique was employed to put forward the MAGDM issues. The probabilistic linguistic term sets (PLTSs) are employed as a technique for characterizing uncertain information during the effectiveness evaluation of university innovation and entrepreneurship education reform. In this paper, the probabilistic linguistic ExpTODIM-MABAC (PL-ExpTODIM-MABAC) technique is constructed to put forward the MAGDM under PLTSs. The MEREC technique is employed to obtain the weight values under PLTSs. Finally, a numerical example for effectiveness evaluation of university innovation and entrepreneurship education reform is put forward to validate the ExpTODIM-MABAC technique.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A hybrid image encryption technique using chaotic map and evolutionary algorithm-based key generation

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11542-1 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Protecting sensitive visual data from unwanted access requires the use of image encryption. This research introduces a robust hybrid image encryption technique that leverages the strengths of chaotic maps and evolutionary algorithms to ensure enhanced security and complexity. The proposed method involves a two-step encryption process. Initially, the image is scrambled using the Logistic Tent Chaotic Map, which disrupts the pixel positions and creates a disordered version of the original image. Following the scrambling process, the disordered image undergoes encryption through a Genetic Algorithm-based key generation scheme combined with a simple XOR operation. The Genetic Algorithm serves as an evolutionary approach to produce highly secure and diverse keys, enhancing the encryption strength. The experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed technique in terms of security, sensitivity to initial conditions, and resistance to common cryptographic attacks. Through rigorous experimentation, the proposed technique demonstrates its efficacy in achieving robust encryption while maintaining computational efficiency. After many analyses, numerical findings demonstrate the algorithm’s robustness against statistical attacks with a maximum entropy of 7.99 and near-zero correlation. By combining the adaptive properties of evolutionary algorithms with the unpredictable nature of chaotic maps, this technique offers a major breakthrough in image encryption. This work presents a hybrid image encryption scheme that integrates a Logistic Tent Chaotic Map with genetic algorithm-based optimized key generation to achieve enhanced security and robustness.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A combined optimization method and wavelet neural network for solving inverse kinematics problems of robot manipulators

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11553-y · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Inverse kinematics (IK) is a fundamental problem in robotics: determining joint configurations for a desired end-effector pose. While neural networks are widely used for this challenge, their susceptibility to local minima and convergence degradation has limited their practical application. This paper proposes to (i) leverage wavelet neural networks (WNNs) to efficiently address the discontinuous nature of IK in robot manipulators and (ii) develop a hybrid training algorithm for robustly avoiding suboptimal extrema and achieving accurate real-time solutions. The training process first employs a meta-heuristic optimization algorithm for parameter space exploration, followed by the Levenberg–Marquardt (LM) method for local refinement. A new fitness-distance balance (FDB) selection method enhances this search and mitigates premature convergence. The method’s high accuracy and real-time performance are demonstrated through testing with a six-degree-of-freedom robot in diverse path-tracking tasks. Comparative validations against various modern algorithms confirm that the proposed IK solver offers advantages including high solution accuracy and reliability.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Consider stock indices and technical indicators to conduct price forecasting for gold and oil: a reinforcement learning perspective

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11554-x · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Rising oil prices often trigger inflation, whereas higher gold prices reflect risk aversion. Analyzing daily data from 2011 to 2025, this study proposes a novel framework to predict commodity prices: (1) raw materials, stock indices, and technical indicators are integrated as the predictors, (2) key performance indicators (KPIs) are identified using MARS (multivariate adaptive regression splines), RF (Random Forest), and XGB (eXtreme gradient boost), and (3) machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL) models including LSTM (long short-term memory) and GRU (gated recurrent unit), and reinforcement learning (RL) strategies such as A2C (advantage actor–critic) and PPO (proximal policy optimization) are compared. Specifically, one-shot splitting starts from 2011 to 2022 for training and uses 2023–2025 is for testing. In dynamic splitting, four-year training and one-month testing is adopted. Results show that average exchange rate of US dollar (USD), coal, India’s stock, Shanghai’s stock, US10YY (10-year yield rate of US treasury bond), Japan’s stock, DJI (US Dow Jones index), and NASDAQ (US technology index) affect oil prices while silver, S&P 500, German’s stock, SOX (US semiconductor index), India’s stock, and NASDAQ influence gold prices. Dynamic splitting and RL models outperform one-shot splitting because they can capture short-term variations and abrupt changes.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

CAST: a novel cost-aware segmentation tree for optimized temporal quality analysis of fuzzy systems

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11565-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper presents a unified framework for modelling and segmenting time-resolved server-quality trajectories derived from fuzzy relational inequalities (FRI). At each time slot, variable-absent FRIs are solved to obtain quality vectors that capture the degree to which servers satisfy imprecise and partially observed QoS constraints. Stacking these solutions yields temporal QoS signals whose regime structure has not been addressed in existing fuzzy-systems literature. To analyse these trajectories, we introduce a QoS-driven penalized cost function that jointly accounts for peak load, sustained elevation, and volatility, reflecting operational priorities more directly than purely statistical discrepancy measures. Building on this formulation, we propose CAST (Cost-Aware Segmentation Tree), a greedy recursive algorithm that inserts split points only when they produce a meaningful reduction in the global QoS-aware objective. CAST inherits the interpretability of fuzzy modelling while providing an efficient and model-agnostic segmentation mechanism. A comprehensive experimental study on 282 synthetic quality trajectories demonstrates that CAST produces coherent and operationally meaningful segments, often outperforming classical change-point detection methods when evaluated under the proposed cost. A real-world validation on the Server Machine Dataset (SMD) further shows that CAST aligns closely with anomalous transitions despite not using anomaly labels. Overall, the proposed framework bridges fuzzy relational modelling with temporal segmentation through a principled cost design, offering an interpretable and operationally grounded tool for proactive server monitoring, diagnosis, and QoS-oriented decision support.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Medical image classification using adaptive fractal neural networks

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11571-w · 摘要来源：已核验来源

In recent years, deep learning methods have been developed to enhance medical image processing and classification. However, existing deep learning algorithms for medical image classification exhibit limitations in feature representation and generalization capabilities. To address these challenges, we propose an innovative adaptive fractal neural network (AFNN) model that integrates fractal theory with deep learning techniques. This model aims to automatically capture, learn, and utilize fractal features in medical images, enabling deep exploration and accurate analysis of the intrinsic complexity of the images. To demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of this approach, brain magnetic resonance imaging data are mapped into a compact, information-rich feature space that effectively captures the primary characteristics of the images. The attention fractal block is employed to precisely focus on key features and is combined with multi-scale analysis of the fractal structure. Consequently, the representativeness and generalization ability of the fused feature representations are enhanced. To further validate the quality of the selected feature subset, these features are input into a downstream classifier as a benchmark evaluation method. Experimental results indicate that the AFNN model exhibits high stability and robustness in brain tumor classification tasks, achieving an accuracy rate of up to 97.75%. This study not only enriches the theoretical framework of deep learning in image processing but also offers novel ideas and methodologies for medical image analysis.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A lightweight transfer learning model for facial emotion recognition

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11579-2 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Facial emotion recognition (FER) faces significant challenges in cross-domain scenarios due to variations in data distribution, limited annotated samples, and computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose FEAR-Net, a novel lightweight network that integrates feature enhancement, cross-domain attention mechanisms, and transfer learning for robust and efficient emotion recognition. First, FEAR-Net employs a multi-level feature fusion module to aggregate hierarchical representations from different convolutional layers, capturing both local and global emotional cues. Then, a dynamic channel attention mechanism adaptively recalibrates feature weights, enhancing discriminative channels while suppressing irrelevant ones. Finally, the model leverages transfer learning with a pre-trained MobileNetV2 backbone to bridge domain gaps and improve generalization. Extensive experiments on FER2013 and CK+ datasets demonstrate FEAR-Net’s superiority over state-of-the-art methods, achieving 75.54% (FER2013) and 97.98% (CK+) accuracy with significantly lower computational costs. Ablation studies validate the contributions of each component, particularly the attention mechanism’s role in cross-domain adaptation.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Bag-of-features modeling of deep and shallow covariance features for 3D facial expression classification

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11527-0 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Facial expression recognition (FER) using 3D face scans has gained significant attention in recent years. Traditional FER techniques rely on 2D imaging, which faces challenges such as illumination changes and pose variations, while projecting 3D images onto 2D planes can result in the loss of critical geometric and topological information. To address these issues, we propose a novel multi-modal FER approach integrating both 2D and 3D features. Shallow features are extracted from 3D images, while deep features are obtained using Convolutional Neural Networks from transformed 2D images. Unlike conventional methods, our approach uses covariance matrices as feature descriptors, preserving spatial relationships and enhancing discriminative power. A covariance matrix learning technique is applied as a manifold layer to reduce the dimensionality of deep covariance matrices while maintaining their structural integrity. The Bag-of-Features paradigm is then employed to quantize the flattened covariance matrices, generating two separate codebooks for shallow and deep features. Finally, a global codebook is used to train a Support Vector Machine classifier. Experimental results, averaged over tenfold cross-validation with multiple training epochs, demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an accuracy of 96.90% ± 1.1 on BU-3DFE with 53.2 ms runtime per face scan, and 94.77% ± 1.3 on Bosphorus, representing improvements of 3–5% over recent 2D+3D FER benchmarks. In a cross-dataset evaluation (training on BU-3DFE and testing on Bosphorus), our method maintains 91.87% ± 1.5 accuracy, significantly higher than traditional cross-dataset baselines that typically fall below 85%. These statistically validated results confirm not only the effectiveness of our hybrid covariance-based representation but also its robustness and generalization capability across datasets with varying acquisition conditions.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Integrating security and fault resilience in smart grid metering: a review of encryption and key management in AMI

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11534-1 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Data has become a vital asset in the digital transformation era, specifically within the electrical power industry, which is facing major changes due to the changeover from traditional systems to Smart Grids. Several significant cybersecurity risks are introduced by this way. In this context, Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) has been acknowledged as one of the principal building blocks of Smart Grids (SGs), as it generates and transmits a great deal of private consumption data, it is one of the primary targets for cyber-attacks. For the smooth operation of the grid, the data generated within AMI should be kept private, safe, and available. This review concerns the coding and data control techniques in the current AMI framework. It presents the advantages and disadvantages of each technique and the aspects that need consideration during the time of implementation. Much emphasis was placed on trade-offs between computational robustness, scalability, and energy efficiency for various cryptographic techniques. This is particularly critical in smart meters, which have a smaller set of resources. There are also several issues that remain to be resolved regarding key distribution and key management, which include problems raised by device heterogeneity and dynamic rekeying. It also provides an overview of the current efforts toward standardization and current trends regarding new technologies. The existing study underlines constant challenges and seeks pathways for the development of robust, scalable, and future proof security solutions for metering networks of the smart grid based on the synthesis of prior research.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Evaluating regression models for link prediction using single-valued neutrosophic sets

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11543-0 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Link prediction involves predicting an absent or possible connection between two nodes in a network. It aids in working with incomplete data, improving recommendations, detecting fraud, and understanding network dynamics. This study proposes a new framework that utilizes Single-Valued Neutrosophic Sets (SVNSs) and cosine similarity to perform link prediction. Based on user ratings, it is implemented on the MovieLens, MovieTweetings, and Anime Recommendation datasets. Twenty regression models were trained for link prediction based on the SVNS lists created for each pair of users. The application of cosine similarity revealed significant insights into the relationship between user ratings. The addition of SVNS enhances the model’s performance manifold. The performance of twenty regression models was compared against several evaluation metrics and visualized using residual plots and prediction error plots. To validate the efficacy of SVNS-based representations, we compare our results against state-of-the-art Graph Neural Networks (GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT) trained on the same task. The proposed methodology using Extra Trees regressor and Extreme Gradient Boosting regressor models provided the best R-squared scores of 0.9100, 0.9380, and 0.7580 for the MovieLens, MovieTweetings, and Anime Recommendation datasets. The proposed models showed better results than baseline models and also promising performance in link prediction. Additionally, we evaluate the approach on the full small version of the MovieLens dataset yielding over 370,000 samples to demonstrate scalability. These findings about the proposed methodology suggest that it can be successful for similar datasets within the same domain.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Advanced intrusion detection in IoT-enabled SDWSNs using artificial intelligence and feature optimization techniques

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11432-6 · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

The widespread deployment of the Internet of Things (IoT) and software-defined wireless sensor networks (SDWSNs) gave rise to new opportunities for smart environments but has also made these systems highly vulnerable to diverse cyberattacks. Conventional intrusion detection systems (IDSs) in IoT-enabled SDWSNs face major challenges such as high-dimensional data, inadequate preprocessing, feature extraction complexities, intricate feature selection, inefficient intrusion recognition, high computational cost, and real-time classification problems, which limit their performance in resource-constrained IoT networks. To address these limitations and challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid IDS framework that integrates three key components, such as the novel exponential grey wolf-optimized grid search algorithm (EGWOGSA), which is a stochastic optimization algorithm, while feature selection is achieved using the novel symmetric gradient Boruta for enhanced feature selection algorithm (SGBFSA), and a gated bidirectional recurrent convolutional neural network (GBR-CNN) algorithm for intrusion recognition. Extensive simulations, using the network simulator 3 (NS-3), were conducted with the NSL-KDD dataset to evaluate the framework for IoT-enabled SDWSNs. Results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms other state-of-the-art models across most metrics, achieving 96.7% training accuracy and 91.6% testing accuracy, with 98.03% precision, 95.9% recall, and a 96.9% F1-score, and demonstrating low energy consumption and latency, high throughput, and a reliable packet delivery ratio (PDR), leading to an extended network lifetime. The study demonstrates that the proposed framework is suitable for real-time deployment. This research contributes to the advancement of security in IoT-enabled SDWSNs by proposing an efficient, accurate, and scalable IDS framework for securing them against evolving threats through advanced feature optimization and artificial intelligence techniques.

Online self-knowledge distillation for financial trading agents using deep learning

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-025-10801-x · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have achieved tremendous progress in several fields over the past years. Despite these successes, employing DNNs for financial time-series analysis remains a notoriously challenging problem. The noisy nature of the data (e.g., similar historical patterns leading to different outcomes) often results in significantly different behaviors between models, even when trained under identical setups. This is because many different hypotheses can equally well explain the training data. Additionally, methods used for generating training labels can further exacerbate these issues. The purpose of this study is to propose a method to overcome these limitations, boost the performance of DNNs in noisy environments, and reduce such instabilities. To this end, we introduce a neural network distillation approach in which a teacher ensemble converts hard labels into soft targets to train a student model, significantly improving performance in noisy environments. Furthermore, we propose an efficient one-step online self-distillation pipeline that enhances profitability while simplifying training by reducing the need for extensive hyperparameter tuning.

论文题名

Blockchain-based distributed federated learning using proof of accuracy consensus

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11492-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper explores integrating federated learning (FL) and blockchain technology, two burgeoning fields in information technology. Despite their growing popularity, both domains face significant challenges. In federated learning, the primary concern is safeguarding the integrity of the general model against client-induced compromises. Blockchain technology grapples with the need for a green mining approach through an energy-efficient consensus protocol. Our study leverages the strengths of each platform to mitigate the weaknesses of the other. We introduce an innovative blockchain-based FL model that eliminates the need for a central aggregator. Utilizing a green mining consensus algorithm named Proof of Accuracy (PoAcc), we create a competitive environment among nodes, fostering the creation of superior models. This approach ensures data integrity and model validation through a community-based consensus, resulting in a fully distributed system. This system enhances FL’s security and scalability and addresses vulnerabilities like malicious aggregators and scalability issues. Through experimental evaluations on the MNIST dataset with 20 miners, on one hand, our method enhances model accuracy to nearly 99% only after 10 blocks, which is a higher point compared to FL and central learning. On the other hand, replacing Proof of Work (PoW) with PoAcc reduces energy consumption by nearly 30%. Moreover, blockchain attacks appeared to be inapplicable or resolvable after 6 blocks, like fork attacks. After all, the introduced incentivizing mechanism lets malicious nodes get nearly zero rewards and allocates main rewards to honest nodes, which is coherent with their efforts to present a superior model.

论文题名

MNA: a multimodal non-autoregressive network for video captioning

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11498-2 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Online videos typically contain various information, and video caption models can use this information to generate video labels. Video caption models are divided into two steps: extracting video information and generating natural language. Currently, the mainstream decoding method is autoregressive decoding, but autoregressive models suffer from low decoding efficiency due to the inability to perform parallel computation. Therefore, we propose a Multimodal Non-Autoregressive video caption model (MNA) that addresses this issue. Compared to autoregressive models, non-autoregressive models have the advantage of parallel computation. To construct the non-autoregressive model in this paper, a bidirectional self-attention network is studied as the basic infrastructure for non-autoregressive decoding. Since non-autoregressive models are parallel computations, the model needs to know the sentence length in advance, so we adopt a length predictor. Moreover, we use a coarse-to-fine video caption generation paradigm to generate more detailed captions. To improve the model's fault tolerance, we randomly sample multiple predicted lengths and generates multiple video captions by the decoder. Meanwhile, a confidence-based video caption selector based on autoregressive decoding is proposed. In the experiments, the autoregressive evaluator is used as the baseline for comparison. The experiment shows that MNA achieves advanced performance, generates rich and accurate descriptions, and improves decoding efficiency.

论文题名

Local consistency cycle generative adversarial networks and its application to image dehazing

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11430-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper addresses the challenge of single-image dehazing in nighttime scenes, where multiple light sources with varying colors, directions, and intensities complicate haze estimation. Traditional dehazing algorithms often struggle in such conditions, leading to issues like color distortion, loss of detail, localized noise enhancement, and insufficient haze removal near light sources. To overcome these challenges, we propose an improved deep learning-based dehazing model built upon Cycle Generative Adversarial Networks (CycleGAN). Our key contributions include: (1) introducing a novel local discriminator design based on the fully convolutional GAN (PatchGAN) architecture to enhance the dehazing performance of CycleGAN by evaluating images through local sampling, and (2) constructing a more diverse and balanced training dataset by extending existing public datasets to include both daytime and nighttime scenes, natural and synthetic images, and varying degrees of mixed haze. Experimental evaluations using Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM) demonstrate that our method achieves a PSNR of 23.17 and an SSIM of 0.92 on the publicly available RESIDE-SOTS dataset, outperforming the original CycleGAN in terms of both metrics. Furthermore, our results validate the effectiveness of the augmented dataset in improving the training performance of CycleGAN for nighttime dehazing applications, highlighting the significance of our approach in advancing robust nighttime image dehazing techniques.

论文题名

Blockchain-assisted shrimp freshness monitoring system using AI and IPFS in cold chain logistics

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11476-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The increasing demand for seafood, particularly shrimp, necessitates robust cold chain logistics to maintain product freshness, ensure food safety, and minimize economic losses. This study proposes an integrated monitoring system that combines artificial intelligence, decentralized storage (IPFS), and private blockchain infrastructure (Hyperledger Fabric) to track and document the freshness of shrimp during cold chain transport. The proposed architecture captures image data and geolocation from vehicle-mounted edge devices, classifies shrimp freshness via the novel deep learning model PentaTriNet, and stores the results in a tamper-evident blockchain system with associated metadata. PentaTriNet, a multi-scale convolutional neural network with three parallel branches utilizing different kernel sizes, demonstrates superior performance in freshness classification tasks, achieving an F1-score of 99.23% for the “fresh” class and an overall validation accuracy of 95.50%. Comparative evaluations show that PentaTriNet outperforms popular models such as EfficientNetV2B0, Xception, and DenseNet121 in terms of both class-wise precision and generalization capability. Furthermore, the system ensures traceability and accountability by storing image hashes on IPFS and logging associated metadata to a permissioned blockchain network. In case of spoilage, automated notifications are triggered, facilitating timely intervention and reducing liability. With its modular architecture and real-time alert capabilities, the system offers a scalable solution that bridges technological innovation and industrial application in seafood logistics.

论文题名

An AI-driven cloud-based loan approval system utilizing multi-task Siamese neural network and Lion optimizer for enhanced risk assessment and decision-making

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11494-6 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The banking sector faces challenges in loan approval due to inefficiency, inconsistent decision-making, and fraud risks. This paper proposes an AI-driven, cloud-enabled loan approval system that integrates a multi-task Siamese neural network (MTSNN) with the Lion (evolved sign momentum) optimizer for enhanced accuracy and stability. The MTSNN jointly performs loan approval prediction, credit scoring, and fraud detection using shared feature learning and task-specific heads, while Lion ensures noise-resilient and fast convergence. A hybrid cloud deployment (AWS + Outposts) ensures low-latency decision-making with compliance to KYC/AML regulations. Experiments on the RPubs Loan Approval dataset (614 instances; 80/20 split; stratified sampling) show superior performance: accuracy (97.94%), precision (98.15%), recall (92.98%), and F1-score (94.54%). Comparative analysis with interpretable models (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM) and ablation studies confirm the advantages of MTSNN and Lion. Fairness evaluation (gender and income groups) and SHAP-based interpretability demonstrate transparent and unbiased decision-making. The proposed system reduces financial risks while enabling faster, secure, and explainable loan approvals. While demonstrated in banking, the proposed MTSNN + Lion + Cloud framework is generalizable to other decision-making applications such as insurance, healthcare eligibility, and e-commerce risk assessment.

论文题名

Visual transformer-based multi-relational perceptual network for facial expression recognition in the wild

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11505-6 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Understanding facial expressions holds great potential in human–computer interaction. While significant progress has been made in facial expression recognition, current methods still struggle with pose and occlusion variations in real-life scenarios. To address this challenge, existing approaches utilize attentional mechanisms or auxiliary information, but often suffer from facial interference and limited relational modeling. In this paper, we propose a Multiscale Local and Global Perception Network (MLGPN), composed of multiscale perception units and multiple MLGP blocks. This network effectively captures global and local features of expression images at varying scales. The global perception unit, based on the visual transformer, models channel and spatial correlations to adaptively learn relationships across dimensions. The hierarchical stacking of MLGP blocks further mitigates the impact of pose variations and occlusions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets, including RAF-DB, FERPlus, and challenging subsets with occlusion and pose variations, demonstrate the superiority of our method over existing techniques.

论文题名

Deep fused hypergraph convolutional neural network for multiclass lung cancer histopathological image classification

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11516-3 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Lung cancer is widely recognised as one of the most life-threatening malignancies. Histopathological diagnosis through visual inspection of tissue slides demands extensive examination time and relies on the pathologist subjective judgment. Accurate subtyping of histopathological images is crucial for effective treatment planning and prognosis. However, prevailing models often struggle to capture higher-order correlations among tissue features leading to reduced classification accuracy and specificity. To address these challenges, a novel depthwise separable hypergraph convolutional neural network (DSHGNet) is proposed for robust multi class lung cancer histopathological image classification. The deep features are extracted using a depthwise separable convolutional neural network (DSConvNet) and k-dimensional hypergraph convolutional neural network (k-HCNN) is designed to efficiently classify the extracted deep features. The proposed model introduces a unique hyperedge group fusion (HGF) mechanism which dynamically fuses correlated hyperedges, thereby enhancing higher-order relational modeling and improving discriminative representation for robust multiclass lung cancer subtyping. The proposed model achieves overall accuracy of 99.89% for LC25000 dataset and 96.03% for LungHist700 dataset outperforming other state-of-the-art algorithms. DSHGNet helps pathologists and medical practitioners differentiate lung cancer subtypes, enabling targeted treatment and effective disease management.

The PMSM rotor develops localized high temperatures at high torque or high speed operating conditions so that the demagnetization failure may occur. To address this problem, this paper proposes a mathematical model to predict rotor temperature rise based on Sparrow Search Algorithm-Back Propagation (SSA-BP) for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM), and the network weights and thresholds are optimized by SSA to improve the local and global optimization ability of the BP neural network. Of course, the comparative analysis shows that the model in this paper has significantly improved in convergence and convergence accuracy compared with several other commonly used models. The mean absolute error (MAE) of the model is 0.245, root mean square error (RMSE) is 0.337, and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) is 0.400% and the overall prediction error does not exceed 1.5 °C.

MV-algebras are the algebraic semantics of Lukasiewicz logic. Modelling intruder behaviour using long short-term memory and gated recurrent unit predictive models

Dire consequences, from money and identity theft to the leaking of confidential data, can be caused by cyberattacks. Therefore, deploying an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) to identify such attacks is important. IDS only raises an alarm on the detection of intrusion; however, stopping such attacks before they cause damage is crucial. Analysis of activity logs using Deep Learning (DL) approaches can help gain insights into mitigating such threats. Hence, the proposed work develops a predictive cybersecurity framework for detecting network intruder behaviour and forecasting the next action of an attacker during data transmission. Here, the proposed framework models the sequential attacker behaviour using honeypot interaction logs, enabling accurate and robust detection of intruder behaviours. As an attack depends on the previous actions performed by the intruder, Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) as well as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) are wielded for modelling the system. GRU and LSTM can handle time series data and find patterns in it. The IP address source is utilized to identify the intruder, and a dense vector representation is devised with the help of embedding. These models give an accuracy of approximately 96%. The results of the two models are evaluated regarding various metrics. Further, they are analyzed using the confusion matrix and compared with each other.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Derived operators on skew orthomodular and strong skew orthomodular posets

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11496-4 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

It is well-known that in the logic of quantum mechanics disjunctions and conjunctions can be represented by joins and meets, respectively, in an orthomodular lattice provided their entries commute. This was the reason why J. Pykacz introduced new derived operations called “sharp” and “flat” coinciding with joins and meets, respectively, for commuting elements but sharing some appropriate properties with disjunction and conjunction, respectively, in the whole orthomodular lattice in question. The problem is that orthomodular lattices need not formalize the logic of quantum mechanics since joins may not be defined if their entries are neither comparable nor orthogonal. A corresponding fact holds for meets. Therefore, orthomodular posets are more accepted as an algebraic formalization of such a logic. The aim of the present paper is to extend the concepts of “sharp” and “flat” operations to operators in skew orthomodular and strong skew orthomodular posets. We generalize the relation of commuting elements as well as the commutator to such posets and we present some important properties of these operators and their mutual relationships. Moreover, we show that if the poset in question is even Boolean then there can be defined a ternary operator sharing the identities of a Pixley term. Finally, under some weak conditions which are automatically satisfied in Boolean algebras we show some kind of adjointness for operators formalizing conjunction and implication, respectively.

论文题名

Multiple hybrid intrusion detection in Internet of Things based on neo-fuzzy deep neural network

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11523-4 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Intrusion detection systems (IDSs) face significant challenges in the Internet of Things (IoT), including dealing with huge amounts of data with numerous features, resource limitations, detection of unknown attacks, and high false alarm rates. This paper introduces a new hybrid model called hybrid multi-classification system (HMCS) that utilizes fog computing to develop efficient IDSs for IoT. In the proposed method, the dataset collected from network traffic is pre-processed, and the feature space is divided into multiple subspaces to reduce processing time. Each subspace is assigned a separate basic classifier called first misuse and next anomaly (FMNA). The FMNA consists of two phases: the first phase involves identifying misuse using a decision tree, while the second phase focuses on anomaly detection using a neo-fuzzy deep neural network for intrusion detection. The decisions of the basic classifiers are then combined based on Dempster–Shafer theory rules to obtain the final result. Simulation results using two datasets, NSL-KDD and UNSW-NB15, demonstrate that the proposed method improves accuracy rates by 1.09 and 0.85% respectively compared to previous works while reducing false alarm rates by 1.47 and 2.27% respectively. Furthermore, the proposed method shows resilience against adversarial attacks as it performs well against four famous adversarial attacks with an average decrease in accuracy of only 3.83%. Overall, this hybrid model based on fog computing offers an efficient solution for developing IDSs in IoT that addresses key challenges such as data volume, resource limitations, unknown attack detection, and false alarm rates while demonstrating resistance against various adversarial attacks.
