摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Fuzzy knowledge measure based accuracy measure with its applications to E-commerce

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11522-5 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Entropy measures the uncertainty of a random variable, while the knowledge measure represents the fuzzy information inherited by a fuzzy set. This work introduces a fuzzy knowledge measure and employs the classic fuzzy VIKOR approach to demonstrate its theoretical and practical value using numerous numerical examples. Its characteristics are analyzed in detail. The advantages of this fuzzy measure are discussed from a variety of perspectives, including the calculation of criteria weights, ambiguity, and the appropriate treatment of structured language variables. In addition, induced measures such as the Accuracy measure and the Information measure are deduced in a fuzzy environment from the proposed knowledge measure. We apply the proposed fuzzy accuracy measure in the VIKOR approach in place of the distance measure. We give an example to show how the proposed approach is applied in solving multi-criteria decision-making problems. We validate the proposed approach through a numerical example, particularly the selection of the best E-Commerce website. Additionally, a flowchart is provided to illustrate this approach. The results of the proposed method are then compared to those of the existing approaches to more accurately reflect the capability and effectiveness of the proposed approach. The scope for additional research is also mentioned at the end of the paper.

论文题名

Modeling external environment impacts on public bus transportation using neutrosophic fuzzy AHP

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11556-9 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

External analysis plays a critical role in identifying developments outside an organization that directly affect its performance. The PESTLE framework, comprising Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Legal, and Environmental criteria, is widely used as a strategic tool for such analysis. This study investigates the external factors influencing public bus transportation systems using the PESTLE framework and develops a two-level hierarchical model. The first level consists of the PESTLE criteria, while the second level includes sub-criteria derived from both the literature and the authors’ expertise. The proposed model is evaluated by transportation experts using the Neutrosophic Fuzzy AHP method, and the results are compared with those obtained through Intuitionistic Fuzzy AHP and Classical AHP. The findings indicate that economic, environmental, and technological criteria are the most influential. A heatmap is presented to illustrate the convergence and divergence among the methods. This study serves as a practical decision-support tool for transportation operators by identifying the external factors that most significantly impact the system. Additionally, it provides guidance for policymakers in addressing critical challenges and promoting the sustainability of public bus transportation systems.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Keyword query over fuzzy RDF knowledge graphs

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11573-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Keyword queries are a popular method of data exploration. Resource Description Framework (RDF) is a standard way to express entities and their relationships. Despite the fact that there are numerous studies on RDF keyword queries, the most of them ignore the knowledge fuzziness. In this paper, we investigate the issue of keyword query over fuzzy RDF graph. Specifically, for the fuzzy RDF graph, we propose a novel keyword query method to retrieve the answers that contain all keywords on the one hand and on the other hand, must have high degrees of confidence. To compute the answer efficiently, we construct an index called Fuzzy Highway Labelling (FHL) based on the idea of distance labelling to compute the shortest path distance and generate the shortest path index containing the possibility information. Based on the FHL and traditional Group Steiner Tree structure, we propose an efficient keyword query algorithm, Fuzzy RDF Keyword Query, which consists of three main parts: obtaining keyword vertices, combining keyword vertices to form candidate paths, and merging candidate paths to generate an answer tree. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our method.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Stability criteria for El Borhamy–Rashad–Sobhy equation induced by fuzzy parameters

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11445-1 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper develops a unified uncertainty-aware framework for modeling, semi-analytical approximation, and stability analysis of parametrically excited electromechanical systems governed by the El Borhamy–Rashad–Sobhy equation (ERS) corroborated by fuzzy parameters. Two representative examples are studied: a single-phase parametric generator with periodically varying inductance and a reduced salient-pole synchronous machine model with weak periodic excitation. To describe epistemic uncertainty, the modulation amplitude is modeled as a triangular fuzzy number and propagated through r-cuts, which yields lower/upper endpoint dynamics at each membership level. Periodic semi-analytical approximations of solutions are obtained using the variational iteration method (VIM) and the modified variational iteration method (MVIM), where MVIM suppresses secular terms to preserve the periodicity. Moreover, the homotopy perturbation method (HPM) is used as an independent check for the derived analytical approximations. For stability, Lyapunov’s direct method provides explicit sufficient stability margins and conservative robust-fuzzy stability boundaries under fuzzy fluctuations. For reference, an interval-based worst-case baseline is also reported by collapsing the fuzzy modulation to its support interval and enforcing the stability inequality under the extreme bounds. The proposed approximations and stability margins are validated against high-accuracy numerical simulations and further confirmed by Floquet multipliers, with MVIM showing the best overall accuracy and robustness.

论文题名

Reliability analysis of a dependent stress-time varying strength degradation model

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11510-9 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper proposes a novel dependent stress-time varying strength degradation (DSTSD) model. To investigate the model s parameters and reliability, statistical inference is performed using degradation data. In this model, a Gamma random process is used to characterize the time-varying strength. The Copula function is used to model the relationship between strength and stress at a given moment, with stress being considered as a random variable. The maximum likelihood (ML) and least squares (LS) methods are used to estimate the model parameters and reliability. Furthermore, the 95% Bootstrap confidence intervals for the model parameters and reliability are obtained. Numerical simulations are conducted to compare the accuracy of the two parameter estimation methods. The results demonstrate the impact of different dependent parameter values and the same sample size on the performance of each method. Finally, the applicability and effectiveness of the proposed DSTSD model are validated through reliability analysis of two practical examples: reservoir water storage and laser current. The results confirm that the model can provide reliable and accurate reliability assessments for these applications.

论文题名

Nyström HSIC-EN based on ridge leverage scores for stable sparse feature selection of high-dimensional unbalanced data and its application

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11493-7 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This paper proposes a novel feature selection method named Nyström Approximation HSIC-EN based on ridge leverage scores, which takes into account the stability, sparsity, and accuracy of feature selection. Firstly, we integrate the Hilbert–Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) into the Elastic Network (EN) framework to evaluate nonlinear feature dependencies and promote feature sparsity. Through this approach, we obtain a stable, non-redundant feature subset highly correlated with the output. Then, considering potential data imbalance, we introduce ridge leverage scores to measure the importance of samples. Finally, to reduce computational complexity and memory requirements, we apply Nyström approximation based on sample importance, thereby achieving more stable and reliable feature selection. This new method is applicable to both classification and regression problems, and its effectiveness has been demonstrated in six high-dimensional classification datasets, including three class-balanced and three class-imbalanced datasets, and a model of hydrogen content prediction in an industrial fluid catalytic cracking process.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Estimation of stress-strength system based on adaptive progressively hybrid censored samples

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11463-z · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The stress-strength (SS) reliability metric is essential to reliability engineering and other scientific disciplines. It aids in forecasting failures of systems, materials, and structures. Using adaptive progressive hybrid censored data, this study evaluates the reliability of a system with two independent random variables, X and Y, which follow an inverse Pareto distribution (IPD). The random variables X and Y represent the strength and stress of the system. This study primarily aims to compare various estimates of SS reliability utilising both frequentist and Bayesian methodologies, specifically maximum likelihood (ML), maximum product spacing (MPS), and bootstrap (boot-p & boot-t) methods for frequentist approaches, alongside MCMC and T–K approximation methods for Bayesian approaches. Bayesian computation presumes the gamma distribution for prior information and uses the squared error loss function for estimations. We perform extensive Monte Carlo simulations to determine the most accurate feasibility of the estimation techniques. The simulated results indicated that the Bayesian estimation approach using MCMC techniques outperformed all other estimate methods. In addition, the adopted methodologies have been fully applied with two illustrative examples.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

MRDSF: a multi-layer reinforcement learning framework for efficient task allocation in cloud, fog, and edge computing

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11535-0 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

In modern distributed computing environments, the integration of cloud, fog, and edge computing has enabled scalable and flexible solutions for handling diverse and dynamic workloads. However, efficiently scheduling tasks across these interconnected layers remains a critical challenge, as the systems must address factors such as energy efficiency, resource constraints, and task completion times. Traditional scheduling approaches often struggle with the variability of tasks and the need for real-time adaptability. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the multilayer reinforcement-driven scheduling framework (MRDSF), an advanced scheduling model that leverages deep reinforcement learning (DRL), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and actor-critic networks to optimize task allocation across cloud, fog, and edge layers. The proposed MRDSF framework dynamically learns and adjusts to task requirements by employing DRL agents that balance exploration and exploitation within a simulated environment. Each computing layer is modeled as a series of nodes with distinct storage capacities, computational power, and latency constraints. The framework incorporates mechanisms for task migration, priority-based task assignment, and system reset functionalities, promoting both scalability and system reliability. Through simulated experiments, MRDSF demonstrates its ability to improve resource utilization, reduce makespan, and maintain energy efficiency across varying workload scenarios. This research provides a comprehensive evaluation of the MRDSF against traditional and state-of-the-art scheduling models, revealing its superior adaptability in heterogeneous environments and its potential for enhancing resource management in distributed computing systems. Our findings highlight key directions for future research in adaptive, multi-layer scheduling frameworks, suggesting that integrating advanced machine learning techniques will further enhance the performance and sustainability of cloud–fog–edge ecosystems. The proposed model is evaluated using both simulated workloads and real-world datasets from Google Cluster Traces and Edge Computing Consortium benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that MRDSF achieves up to 28% improvement in resource utilization, 22% reduction in makespan, and 18% enhancement in energy efficiency compared with traditional and state-of-the-art scheduling algorithms. Additionally, MRDSF exhibits strong scalability and robustness under varying workload intensities, maintaining consistent performance with minimal overhead.

Incremental attribute reduction for partially labeled data

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11547-w · 摘要来源：已核验来源

In the age of big data, technological advancements have made it easier to gather large volumes of information from diverse sources, with a significant portion of these data being partially labeled. Currently, many rough set-based attribute reduction algorithms exist for this type of data. However, those algorithms are limited to static data only and cannot be directly applied to dynamic data. In this paper, we propose a novel incremental semi-supervised attribute reduction for dynamic and partially labeled data that enable to handle semi-supervised data in dynamic environments. The proposed method can make full use of previous reduction information to update the reduct incrementally. In the proposed method, first, attribute selection based on discernible pairs for labeled and unlabeled data is proposed. Second, an algorithm for a static is dataset used, third, the mechanism for updating reduct is defined. Fourth, an algorithm for updating the reduct for dynamic data is presented. An experiment with eight UCI public datasets is conducted. The results show that the proposed approach outperformed other semi-supervised baseline approaches in terms of computational time while sustaining accuracy, which is worthy of attention.

More and more researchers are paying attention to the research of industrial big data scheduling process in collaborative artificial intelligence of things (abbreviated as AIoT). However, there exists jitters in the process of data synchronization and interaction in the system, which leads to the failure of update transaction transmission, and the sensor data cannot be upload into the database. Therefore, The following key problems must can be considered. One is to reduce the runtime workload of transactions and data communication. The other one is to consider that when the transaction load demand of the system is distributed to different nodes, the tasks on each node need to communicate with each other during execution, and the jitters in the transmission cannot be ignored. The proposed method IMJB-EDF can solve the problems. The experimental results show that compared to the existing methods, the proposed method has better performance in transaction acceptance ratio, run-time load demand, and transaction aging.

论文题名

Detection and classification of knee osteoarthritis severity levels using a Puma optimized YOLOv8-GAN framework

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11514-5 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The goal of this study is to design a specific and efficient system for early detection and severity classification of knee osteoarthritis. Conventional methods often face problems such as low Accuracy, a lack of sufficient feature extraction, and low efficiency in recognising early-stage osteoarthritis (OA), which may prevent timely treatment. To tackle these obstacles, this research introduces an innovative Puma-based Generative Adversarial YOLOv8 (PbGAY) model that integrates optimised feature selection, accurate region segmentation, and strong classification capabilities. This model analyses data using a MATLAB framework, where the data undergoes preprocessing to reduce noise and enhance visualisation. Essential features are identified using the Puma optimisation technique, followed by the segmentation of the affected joint area utilising YOLOv8. A GAN-based model directs the ultimate classification into five OA severity categories: Healthy, Doubtful, Minimal, Moderate, and Severe. The categorised severity is used for the YOLOv8 model, which estimates severity in percentage terms. Experimental results show that the PbGAY model surpasses current techniques in terms of Precision, recall, and F1-score, making it a robust and reliable tool for early OA diagnosis. The suggested PbGAY model exhibited exceptional performance in classifying the severity of OA. It achieved 98.58% precision, 98.62% recall, and 98.65% accuracy, demonstrating its high ability to accurately identify and classify OA conditions. Furthermore, this model achieved an impressive F-measure of 98.60%, indicating a solid balance between Precision and recall. Moreover, the error rate was significantly low at only 1.42%, confirming the reliability and robustness of the proposed method in clinical diagnostic settings.

论文题名

Multi-source information fusion based attributed heterogeneous network embedding

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11533-2 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Attributed heterogeneous information network embedding is a research field focused on embedding nodes with complex heterogeneous information into a low-dimensional space while preserving their rich attributes. Existing methods often rely on single-source information or shallow models to fuse multi-source information, which may lead to the loss of network information and suboptimal network embedding quality. To address this issue, we propose a model called MAHE (multi-source information fusion based attributed heterogeneous network embedding) that leverages deep fusion techniques to improve embedding performance. MAHE calculates attribute and structure similarities of nodes using different meta-paths, and fuses multiple heterogeneous similarity matrices to complement attribute information with semantic information. The embeddings of nodes are learned using an auto-encoder on each multi-source similarity matrix. Furthermore, an attention mechanism is employed to fuse these node embeddings and capture the importance of different multi-source embeddings. Experimental results on three datasets demonstrate the superiority and effectiveness of the MAHE model.

论文题名

Model selection criterion for multivariate asymmetric Student’s-t mixture model with bounded support data

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11499-1 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) are very useful and widely popular for clustering, but they have several limitations, such as low outliers tolerance and assumption of data normality. Another problem in relation to finite mixture models in general is the inference of an optimal number of mixture components. An excellent approach to solve this problem is model selection, which is the process of choosing the optimal number of mixture components that ensures the best clustering performance. In this paper, we attempt to tackle both aforementioned issues. We consider the task of modeling multidimensional data by a multivariate bounded asymmetric Student’s t-mixture model (BASMM) without knowing the prior number of clusters. We then propose minimum message length (MML) as a model selection criterion on top of the BASMM clustering. We test our resulting model with three different experiments: household electricity consumption profiles clustering, head pose estimation from drivers’ images, and leukemia detection from genetic expression. The results of these experiments are discussed and compared with other model selection criteria and clustering algorithms to demonstrate the merits of our contribution.

High-dimensional, small-sample (HDSS) spectral data present critical challenges for model stability and generalization in sparse partial least squares (SPLS) regression. Existing data partitioning strategies—such as Kennard–Stone (KS), SPXY, bootstrap, and Monte Carlo methods—often fail to generate representative training and test sets, leading to suboptimal hyperparameter tuning and unstable model performance. In this study, we propose SP–SPLS, a novel modeling framework that integrates SPLS with a support point–based data partitioning method known as the SPlit approach. This strategy ensures better test set representativeness by minimizing statistical discrepancy, thereby enhancing model robustness. We evaluate the proposed SP–SPLS method through extensive simulations and two real-world near-infrared (NIR) spectral datasets related to sugarcane quality assessment. Experimental results show that SP–SPLS consistently outperforms traditional SPLS variants in terms of predictive accuracy, stability, and reliability of variable selection. This study provides new insights into data partitioning for sparse modeling and highlights the practical value of support-point strategies in measurement-driven high-dimensional applications.

Interval norm approach for solving two player zero sum matrix games with interval payoffs

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11513-6 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This article explores the interval matrix game model by presenting a new approach for solving a two-player zero-sum interval-valued matrix game based on the interval matrix norm framework. The methodology presented in our work helps obtain an approximated interval game value for the corresponding zero-sum interval matrix game without undergoing the existing process of solving traditional interval linear mathematical models. In this direction, we initially propose the concept of an interval 1− norm and ∞− norm for the interval matrix game problem. Later on, based on the proposed interval norm concept, some new results have been developed, highlighting some necessary conditions to obtain the optimum interval boundaries for the interval game value. Furthermore, an efficient method is developed based on the normalization concept to obtain the appropriate bounds for the largest and smallest element within the mixed strategy set for the corresponding game players. Finally, the established method is adapted to solve a telecommunication market share problem case study and comparison of results with the traditional techniques demonstrates the proposed method’s consistency, applicability, and superiority. Although well-known interval linear programming techniques have been developed in the literature to obtain optimal strategies and interval game value, we believe that the proposed method will bring an empirical viewpoint to understand the imprecise matrix game theory. In addition, the concept provided in this study will bring about a significant contribution to the abounding literature on interval matrix games and future studies in this discipline.

One of the critical operations in analyzing social networks is community detection. Society is also a set of coherent vertices, where internal communication within the society exceeds communication outside it. In many real-world networks, communities can overlap. This paper employs an overlapping community detection using a multi-objective optimization approach based on learning automata, which have been used to hybridize and reduce computational load intelligently. Artificial Gorilla Troops Optimizer (GTO), Fruit Fly Optimization (FFO) algorithms, and Quantum Rotary Gate (QRG) are used for this purpose and then integrated with the Pareto dominance technique. Also, fuzzy clustering and initialization strategies have been used for overlapping community detection. The tests in this paper are based on 16 real-world and synthetic data sets. The proposed model's findings were compared to existing optimization techniques, demonstrating that it outperforms the examined approaches.

论文题名

A novel evaluation process for customer-oriented strategies for virtual sales using the Pythagorean fuzzy TOPSIS method in the COVID-19 pandemic: cases of food chain stores

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11567-6 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Buying goods is a fundamental human need that has evolved from traditional face-to-face shopping to modern virtual shopping, driven by smart technology with the internet. The COVID-19 pandemic has challenged the traditional chain store shopping, pushing chain stores to adopt new strategies to retain and attract customers, particularly through virtual sales. In this study, five customer-oriented strategies are selected based on expert opinions from 250 customers who have shopping experience from selected four food chain stores in Tehran. The performances of four food chain stores has been analyzed and evaluated. The collected data have been assessed using the technique for order of preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) for Pythagorean fuzzy (PF-TOPSIS) techniques. According to the findings; the managers at store 4 performed the best; they could attract more customers by maintaining the service strategy and enhancing the cost management strategy. The managers of the first store need to modify the tenets of their quality strategy even if they continue to have a lot of potential in the information technology strategy. Managers of store 3 have performed admirably in terms of cost and marketing management compared to other stores; but, in order to capture a larger portion of the target market, they might have to enhance their services and technology. Finally, the managers of store 2, even with the weakest performance, can improve by strengthening their marketing strategy. This study adds to the body of knowledge to the related domain by introducing an application of PF-TOPSIS in evaluating customer-oriented strategies under uncertainty in the virtual sales context, offering both methodological and managerial insights.

Deeper fine-tuned autoencoder for user datagram protocol flooding network traffic detection in Internet of Things

The increase in the use of Internet of Things devices operating online has led to an increase in cyber-attacks with these devices. One of the uncontrolled attacks performed with a botnet is User Datagram Protocol flooding. It is necessary to develop an effective method to detect abnormal UDP flooding traffic IOT devices that are compromised. Effective detection of these anomalies is very important for the systems to maintain their services regularly. Although machine learning, shallow neural networks and deep learning methods are used to detect abnormal traffic, it is suggested that the effective measurement metrics should be selected and applied to a fine-tuned auto-coder architecture in this study. Therefore, we propose a model with high accuracy and performance by coding selected deeper features for the detection of flooding attacks on IOT devices. The proposed method is verified with UDP-flood data in the N-BaIOT and NSL-KDD test datasets. The proposed method proved to be successful in terms of Cohen kappa, f1 score, sensitivity and accuracy metrics obtained in the experimental results. Experiments in the study showed that the number of optimally selected features was significantly reduced, resulting in the lowest detection time. This enabled a more optimized and feasible design with encoded deeper features.

Optimal feature fusion and generative adversarial network for multimodal biometrics recognition

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11507-4 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Biometric models are used for identifying the legitimate user to provide security. Biometrics refers to a technology designed to evaluate physical characteristics and has become an essential tool for human authentication. Although existing biometric authentication methods provide several advantages, they often face challenges such as limited accuracy and robustness. Integrating multiple biometric modalities helps overcome these issues and enhances overall authentication performance. Thus, this research outlines a novel multimodal biometric recognition approach based on the Ant Lion Border Collie Optimization (ALBCO) and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). Here, palm print images, fingerprint images, finger knuckle, iris, and finger vein images are acquired and fed to pre-processing. The produced pre-processed image undergoes feature extraction. Features like LOOP, Daugman’s rubber sheet model, LGP, minutiae points, and grid features are extracted and given to the feature fusion phase. The optimally weighted coefficients are generated using the devised ALBCO in fusion. The proposed ALBCO combines Ant Lion Optimizer (ALO) and Border Collie Optimization (BCO). The fused features are further given to the GAN for multimodal biometric recognition. The proposed ALBCO-based GAN offered improved performance with the highest accuracy of 0.945, the lowest FAR of 0.064, and the lowest FRR of 0.109.

论文题名

Glaucoma diagnosis from color fundus images via joint end-to-end learning of interpretable morphological features

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11511-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The analysis of color fundus images is crucial to facilitate the early diagnosis of glaucoma, an eye condition that usually remains asymptomatic until the onset of noticeable vision loss. Deep neural networks are able to achieve remarkable results in the detection of glaucoma. However, the black-box nature of these algorithms usually limits their adoption in clinical settings. In this context, we propose a novel end-to-end deep learning approach that uses interpretable morphological features to predict the presence of glaucoma. These features are clinically inspired and easily understandable, so they can facilitate the trust in the predictions. The use of morphological features has been previously explored in multi-step approaches, usually requiring the segmentation of the images. However, our proposal is the first method to integrate these interpretable features within a deep neural network for image classification while also enabling the end-to-end training of both the features and the diagnosis. To validate our proposal, we perform extensive experiments on publicly available datasets. The results show that our methodology is able to successfully learn both the morphological features and the diagnosis, while also making the prediction of the diagnosis solely based on the learned features. Additionally, besides the implicit benefits in interpretability, the knowledge provided by the morphological features also improves the performance of the diagnosis. This results in a novel single-step method that is highly competitive with the state-of-the-art. All in all, our proposal shows a great potential to facilitate the adoption of end-to-end deep learning methodologies in clinical settings.

论文题名

An intelligent hybrid forecasting model for efficient compressive strength prediction

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11575-6 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The physical testing of concrete compressive strength is expensive, consumes more time, and more prone to human error. Therefore, a competent automatic intelligent method is immensely anticipated. This article proposes an elitist chemical reaction optimization with Nelder–Mead simplex algorithm based dendritic neuron model named as ECRON-DNM for efficient compressive strength prediction of concrete structures. The improvements in ECRON are achieved over basic chemical reaction optimization (CRO) through: (i) a new initialization of population for ensuring population diversification, (ii) integration of Nelder–Mead simplex method for intensification of local search ability, and (iii) elitism concept to advance the convergence towards global optima by retaining the finest solutions attained so far. The ECRON is used to expedite the predictability of a DNM through adjustment of its hyper-parameters. Consequently, an optimal ECRON-DNM structure is shaped in an automatic manner. The proposed method is then applied on compressive strength prediction of concrete structures using three standard datasets. The ECRON-DNM based predictions are found accurate over DNM trained with basic CRO, particle swarm optimization (PSO), genetic algorithm (GA), and gradient descent technique. Considering three datasets, the proposed method achieved an average MAPE value of 5.3185, RMSE of 1.2775, MAE 1.4317 and R² value of 0.9852, which are significantly better than that of baseline methods. Additionally, to understand the contribution and importance of input features towards deciding compressive strength, explainable methods are used. To advance the ECRON-DNM predictions further, training data are boosted with interpolated data. Overall, by using ECRON-DNM, data interpretation and interpolated data, this article designs an efficient predictive model for compressive strength prediction.

论文题名

Design of a fixed-time multi-layer neural network controller for underactuated autonomous underwater vehicles

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11440-6 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

In this paper, a novel multi-layer neural network controller is proposed for a five-degrees-of-freedom model of underactuated autonomous underwater vehicles to precisely track a three-dimensional trajectory. To this end, a second-order dynamic model is developed in terms of relative distance and relative azimuth and elevation angles on the basis of a coordinate transformation which inherits all the structural properties of the original dynamic model. Then, an effective sliding surface is proposed to design a fixed-time controller. Since the underwater vehicle is a highly uncertain and nonlinear multi-input multi-output system, a multi-layer neural network is designed to estimate and compensate for unknown nonlinear dynamics of the vehicle by designing on-line learning rules. The neural network approximation error, disturbances and ocean currents are compensated by a saturation-type adaptive robust controller. Lyapunov direct method will prove that all the closed-loop control signals are bounded and tracking errors will converge to a vicinity of the origin before a predefined time. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed fixed-time controller will be shown by computer numerical simulations.

Multimodal humor detection in videos via domain-specific representations and deep hybrid fusion networks

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11544-z · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Multimodal data analysis plays a pivotal role in understanding human-centric content by integrating text, visual, and audio cues. Humor detection in videos remains particularly challenging due to temporal misalignment across modalities, data imbalance, and noise in real-world signals. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework for multimodal humor detection that combines Domain-Specific Representation Learning (DSRL) with a Deep Hybrid Fusion Network (DHFN) Our approach disentangles modality-invariant and modality-specific features through a Bi-LSTM based DSRL module and integrates them via cross-modal attention with suppression mechanisms in DHFN. Experiments on benchmark datasets including IEMOCAP, CMU-MOSI, and CMU-MOSEI demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 95.8% accuracy. Comprehensive ablation studies and precision–recall analyses further confirm the robustness and efficiency of the framework. These results highlight the potential of domain-aware multimodal fusion for advancing affective video understanding while also pointing to ethical considerations and deployment challenges in real-world humor recognition.

Stability analysis and numerical simulation of complex fractional models via a direct meshless local Petrov–Galerkin method

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11541-2 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

In this article, an efficient hybrid numerical strategy is developed to obtain approximate solutions of a time-fractional model involving a distributed-order Riesz space operator over the computational domain. The proposed scheme combines the finite difference method with the direct meshless local Petrov–Galerkin (DMLPG) approach. The temporal discretization is carried out using a finite difference approximation, while the spatial component of the model is treated through the DMLPG framework. In addition, the distributed-order integral containing the Riesz space operator is approximated using a Gauss–quadrature technique. A detailed analysis of stability and convergence is provided to ensure the reliability of the method. Finally, a numerical example is presented to demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed approach.

论文题名

Neutrosophic image fusion for multi-modal brain images: an innovative approach

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11539-w · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The fusion of brain images acquired from multiple modalities poses a significant challenge in neuroimaging due to the inherent presence of uncertainty, imprecision, and data variability. Neutrosophic set theory has emerged as a promising mathematical framework to address these complexities. This research introduces a single-valued neutrosophic entropy-driven fusion framework integrated with Tamura texture features for effective multi-modal brain image fusion. Initially, the crisp images undergo transformation into the neutrosophic domain, and introduce a single-valued neutrosophic entropy metric to effectively extract information from the neutrosophic image. Subsequently, texture features are extracted using Tamura’s roughness feature methodology. The fusion of images is then executed based on the quantified information derived from the extracted features. The primary contributions of this work include (i) the systematic application of neutrosophic set theory for uncertainty-aware multi-modal brain image fusion, (ii) the development of a novel single-valued neutrosophic entropy measure for enhanced information extraction, and (iii) the integration of Tamura roughness-based texture features to guide an information-driven fusion strategy. Moreover, to ascertain the effectiveness of the proposed method, comprehensive assessments are conducted, encompassing both qualitative and quantitative evaluations. Comprehensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations against state-of-the-art methods demonstrate that the proposed single-valued neutrosophic entropy and Tamura feature-based fusion framework achieves superior performance.

Alzheimer’s disease (AD), which is one of the leading causes of dementia, is a degenerative neurological condition that typically develops slowly and worsens over time. Alzheimer’s disease affects memory and cognitive abilities, and it is a prevalent condition worldwide. Early diagnosis of the disease is crucial to mitigate its irreversible effects, but traditional diagnostic methods have limitations. Recent advancements in neuroimaging, biomarkers, and deep learning algorithms have opened up new possibilities for early detection and accurate diagnosis of the condition. In this research, we develop a multi-stage ensemble classifier model that can classify Alzheimer’s disease into four categories: very mild dementia, mild dementia, moderately severe dementia, and non-dementia, using 6400 MRI scans. To address the black-box nature of deep learning models in medical imaging, we integrate Grad-CAM visualization techniques to interpret the classification results of Alzheimer’s disease stages. This method allows us to identify the most influential regions in MRI scans that drive the model’s decisions, thereby increasing the reliability and clinical trust in the automated diagnosis process. The proposed deep ensemble model achieved an accuracy of 98.71% and an AUC of 99.13%, outperforming other state-of-the-art methods.

Extracting text information from natural scene images poses a significant challenge in computer vision due to various factors caused by the complexity of character designs and the variety of degradations in the wild. Despite the growing prevalence of camera devices and the advancements in embedded visual processing, there has been significant progress in the area of text detection, there is a scarcity of resources dedicated to the extraction of multilingual text from the wild. To overcome the shortage of available data for text detection in natural scenes images, specifically focusing on Arabic scripts language, this paper presents a new multilingual dataset named SYPHAX. It covers the detection of scene text in both Arabic and Latin languages. The dataset consists of 2008 images that were gathered manually from Tunisia in “Sfax” city, the second largest Tunisian city after the capital also attached to the old historical name “Syphax”. The 7 categories of objects were manually annotated in the dataset. The SYPHAX dataset’s annotated images are comprised of over 28,900 objects enclosed by bounding boxes. The article shows the originality of the dataset and studies the different existing natural challenges, by assessing the effectiveness of the most advanced algorithms for text detection. Experiments with representative state-of-the-art text detection models demonstrate competitive performance and highlight the importance of annotation granularity alignment for improved detection accuracy. The dataset is publicly available via IEEE DataPort.

论文题名

Numerical bifurcation analysis of Carreau fluid in asymmetric peristaltic regime

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11551-0 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

This article provides numerical bifurcation analysis of the stagnation points in an asymmetric peristaltic flow of a Carreau fluid. A non-linear differential equation is obtained in terms of stream function after using the simplifying assumptions of long wavelength and negligible inertia. A numerical solution to this equation is obtained with the aid of the Mathematica solver NDSolve. The obtained numerical solution is then utilized in conjunction with the qualitative theory of dynamical systems to identify and classify the stationary points. The impact of the material parameter of the Carreau model on the emergence and evolution of stationary points is thoroughly examined through local and global bifurcation diagrams. This study examines the changes in flow topology through the channel when partial obstruction occurs. Furthermore, this analysis presents that the trapping phenomenon is predominantly controlled by the power-law index and the Weissenberg number. Enhancement of the power-law index amplifies bolus formation and expands the trapping region, whereas increasing elastic effects reduces the size of recirculation zones. The results of this research could aid in maintaining smooth fluid flow through the pump, minimizing the risk of entrapment from inlet to outlet. Also, if eddying zone is occurring, these insights can be beneficial in detecting the specific location within the pump where the fluid is being trapped.

论文题名

A synergistic deep learning and game theory framework for enhanced optimization of linkage design

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11555-w · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Four-bar linkages, essential components of machinery, are extensively utilized across diverse engineering and scientific disciplines. The synthesis of planar four-bar linkages entails the determination of geometric parameters to achieve specific motion requirements, traditionally addressed through intricate mathematical formulations and empirical methods. Recent advancements have seen the integration of machine learning (ML) techniques, including artificial neural networks (ANNs) and genetic programming (GP), showing potential in automating and enhancing the design process. This study delves into the utilization of deep-learning methodologies and game theoretic principles for the optimal design of crank-rocker/slider and path-generating four-bar mechanisms. Leveraging sophisticated machine learning approaches, the research presents an optimal design of a four-bar crank-rocker mechanism using deep-learning meta-modelling techniques. The primary objective is to design a mechanism with desired stroke and time ratio values, with mechanism link lengths serving as key design parameters. Moreover, a Stackelberg/cooperative game scenario, in conjunction with genetic algorithms, is proposed for the multi-objective optimal design of path-generating four-bars. This approach accounts for various factors such as tracking error, transmission angle, and coupler workspace, to model cooperative/hirarchical behavior and optimize mechanism design. The study showcases the potential of machine learning and game theoretic methodologies in enhancing linkage performance and introducing a structured hierarchical formulation. The presented mechanisms demonstrate superiority compared to existing literature, underscoring the efficacy of advanced machine learning techniques in mechanism synthesis.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A structured and transparent hybrid cyberattack detection framework for smart grids: enhanced system for zero-day exploit identification

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11478-6 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Smart grid infrastructures face escalating threats from zero-day exploits and dynamic cyberattacks, requiring highly adaptive and transparent detection mechanisms. Existing intrusion detection systems often lack robust preprocessing, deep contextual feature extraction, and reproducible experimental clarity, limiting their effectiveness in real-world deployments. To address these gaps, this study proposes a structured multi-stage hybrid framework that integrates advanced signal processing, optimized feature selection, and deep neural architectures for comprehensive exploit detection. The framework begins with an Adaptive WavePCA-Autoencoder module combining wavelet denoising, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and reconstruction-based filtering to reduce noise and enhance signal quality. A Meta-Attention Transformer Autoencoder subsequently performs deep temporal–spatial feature learning, while the Genetic Mongoose–Chameleon Optimization (GMCO) algorithm further refines features beyond conventional PCA outputs to maximize discrimination power. The final detection is performed using the Adaptive Hybrid Exploit Detection Network (AHEDNet), which integrates GRU-CNN, RCNN-BiLSTM, and an ensemble neural classifier for robust decision-making. Experiments were conducted on publicly available smart grid cybersecurity datasets using a clearly defined training–validation–testing split, optimized hyperparameters, and a fully documented hardware–software environment to ensure reproducibility. Results averaged over multiple trials demonstrate high accuracy (98.55%), strong F1-scores, reduced false alarm rates, and resilience against DDoS and zero-day attacks. Ablation studies confirm the necessity of each module, showing substantial performance drops when individual components are removed. While the framework provides strong detection capabilities, limitations include computational complexity and dependence on labeled data.

论文题名

Decoupled multi-dimensional reinforcement learning with temporal communication for vision-based UAV control in partially observable environments

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11519-0 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Autonomous UAV navigation in complex environments has attracted increasing attention in recent years due to its wide range of applications in robotics and intelligent transportation systems. However, vision-based UAV control in partially observable and dynamic environments remains challenging because of limited perception and the need to coordinate multiple control dimensions simultaneously. This paper proposes a reinforcement learning approach for such scenarios. Traditional methods typically employ a single, monolithic policy to jointly control throttle, roll, pitch, and yaw, which often leads to complex representations and degraded performance under partial observability. To address this issue, we introduce a decoupled policy framework that decomposes the UAV action space into separate control dimensions, reformulating the problem as a multi-agent setting. Each dimension is handled by an independent policy with a shared feature backbone, and coordinated through a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) communication mechanism to capture temporal dependencies. Experiments conducted in the photorealistic Flightmare simulator on obstacle avoidance, target tracking, and object search tasks demonstrate consistent performance gains over strong baselines. Specifically, the proposed method improves task success rates by approximately 10∼ 25%, reduces collision rates by up to 30%, and achieves faster convergence during training.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

An oversampling algorithm to balance high-dimensional and noisy data

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11474-w · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Class imbalance is a challenge in real-world datasets, particularly in environments with non-uniform data distributions. Common events generate abundant data, while rare events result in underrepresented minority classes. Noise and high dimensionality further complicate existing solutions, as they often introduce noisy or redundant samples and struggle to capture complex feature relationships in high-dimensional spaces. To address this problem, we propose an oversampling algorithm designed to generate robust samples. First, the algorithm applies KMedoids clustering as a preliminary step. This method groups samples around medoids, which serve as robust central representatives resistant to noise and outliers. Second, it uses a specified distance metric to create synthetic samples. We compare the Manhattan and Euclidean distances to determine which better preserves the local structure and yields more realistic samples in noisy, high-dimensional datasets. We validate our approach against various oversampling methods on 12 datasets characterized by noise and diverse class-imbalance ratios. Compared to state-of-the-art algorithms, our proposed method, using the Manhattan distance, achieves superior classification performance in terms of G-Mean, demonstrating its competitive performance and robustness on imbalanced datasets. The Wilcoxon tests confirm that these improvements are significant, highlighting the algorithm’s effectiveness in balancing the class distributions within noisy, high-dimensional data.

论文题名

A hybrid approach of VAE with a deep neural network for quality-related distributed process monitoring

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11512-7 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The scale of modern manufacturing production systems is increasing, and centralized quality monitoring methods are unable to detect partial failures due to the complexity of high-dimensional data processing and the ignoring of local information. The existing monitoring method pays little attention to the sequential correlation between the manufacturing units, thus ignoring or suppressing some potential fault information and fails to identify early faults or partial faults in the mass production system. This paper proposes a probabilistic learning model using a deep neural network for distributed process quality monitoring. We first employ the Girvan-Newman algorithm to divide the complex production system into modular sub-units. Secondly, the LSTM neural network is used to improve the VAE probability generation model to analyze the time sequence of the process variables in each sub-unit. Finally the sub-units are merged, and the T² and SPE indicators are used for fault detection to analyze the quality monitoring performance of the model. The proposed model is validated on two cases, the Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) and a Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR). Across both cases, the VAE-LSTM framework accurately identifies faults and pinpoints the responsible sub-units, while achieving higher FDR (Fault Detection Rate) and lower FAR (False Alarm Rate) than VAE-DNN, PCA, and KPCA, thereby demonstrating strong cross-domain robustness.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A stacked ensemble artificial neural network algorithm for efficient solar energy prediction

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11437-1 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

To harvest solar energy in photovoltaic power plants, accurate prediction of global solar radiation (GSR) is crucial. We propose a novel computational intelligence framework using stacked ensemble Artificial Neural Network (EANN) and Chi-Maximal Information Coefficient (Chi-MIC) feature selection method to forecast GSR at six solar energy farms in Queensland, Australia. To make our method valid for solar energy industry application, we adopt meteorological datasets from global climate models and ground observations where the proposed EANN model is trained to use three ANN algorithms (as base learner systems) and the results are integrated using another ANN (as a meta regressor system) to accurately predict GSR. To appraise the predictive capability of the proposed EANN model, we consider Deep Learning (Deep Neural Network, Deep Belief Network and Long Short-Term Memory Network) and Machine Learning (Radial Basis Function, Multi Adaptive Regression Spline, Gaussian Process of Regression, Boosting Random Forest Regression and M5 Model Tree). The results, evaluated using statistical metrics, show the proposed EANN model attains the highest accuracy for all six solar farms with a root mean square error (RMSE) between 2.200−3.831 MJ m² day⁻¹ and a relative RMSE 10.343%−19.003%, which was significantly lower than all benchmark models. Likewise, the normalised metrics registered the highest Willmott’s Index of 0.875−0.928 and Legates & McCabe’s Index of 0.482−0.974 compared to benchmark models and the skill score measuring the performance edge of EANN over all benchmark models registered the highest value between 0.700−0.757 in contrast to benchmark models (0.372−0.753) for all six study sites. To rank the EANN model, the Gray relational degree of each model ranking based on Gray relational analysis for six solar farm sites reported the highest performance rank for EANN against nine benchmark models. These metrics, along with visual analysis of predicted and observed GSR, reaffirm the proposed EANN as being considerably robust and scalable to solar energy monitoring systems, and other applications such as wind, tidal and geothermal power. Our method can contribute towards developing strategic measures for sustainable development and increased solar energy mix in today’s energy markets.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

MGDN: a multi-graph dual-attention network for personalized recommendation

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11509-2 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

As a popular graph learning technique, graph neural networks (GNNs) show great advantages in personalized recommendations. Existing GNN-based recommendation methods constructed graphs with various relationships, and then captured structural information in graphs for personalized recommendation. However, they faced two limitations. First, feature-level similarity of users or items are not considered effectively, which results in limited information being used to represent users and items. Second, existing GNNs ignore the mutual association between neighbor nodes in information propagation, which results in structured information in graphs not being sufficiently captured. To overcome these deficiencies, we develop a multi-graph dual-attention network, MGDN, for personalized recommendation. Specifically, MGDN firstly constructs multiple graphs according to feature-level similarity of users or items as well as the interaction between users and items, which promotes representations of users or items. Moreover, MGDN designs the graph dual-attention network (GDN) to conduct information propagation, which more accurately captures structural information in each graph. Furthermore, rich experiments are conducted with four benchmark datasets on recommendation, and results indicate that MGDN obviously outperforms mainstream recommendation methods.

File fragment type identification based on parallel cross convolutional neural network

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11503-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

File fragment type identification is a critical research topic in digital forensics. However, current methods still face numerous challenges, including low accuracy, reliance on manually designed features, and limited coverage of file types. To address these limitations, inspired by binocular vision principles, we propose a Parallel Cross Convolutional Neural Network (PCCNN) architecture. This architecture overcomes the limitations of single-structure design and insufficient feature extraction in existing models. The PCCNN can automatically learn features from raw bytes. It extracts features through parallel left and right branch networks, conducts multiple feature concatenation and convolution operations, and fuses feature information from different branches, thereby achieving more comprehensive feature extraction and improving model performance. On the FFT-75 dataset, our model outperforms FiFTy. Compared with the FiFTy model, the average accuracy across six scenarios is improved by 15%, and in the 75-classification scenario, the average accuracy reaches 78.4%.

SeqCA-Net: sequential multi-scale channel attention for multi-label bird species classification in field recordings

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11538-x · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The identification of bird species through automatic analysis of their vocalizations shows potential for a range of fields, including ecology, conservation monitoring, and studies on vocal behavior. In recent times, this has emerged as a heavily researched area, with numerous studies employing deep-learning models to categorize bird calls. However, the performance of these models is often limited by the small and imbalanced datasets available. Mel-spectrogram and Mel frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) are extracted in the front end. We explore the effectiveness of convolutional networks and aggregated residual transformation network (ResNeXt) with a cutting-edge Channel Attention model using sequential aggregation strategy, which we denote as SeqCA-Net, for multi-label bird classification. Two variants of SeqCA-Net have been proposed, namely, SeqCA-MS-CNN and SeqCA-MS-ResNeXt, respectively. Our objective is to develop a reliable model capable of real-time identification of bird species through their calls, even when constrained by a limited volume of training data. Our findings show that this approach, particularly the SeqCA-MS-CNN model, achieved an F1 metric of 86.22% using MFCC, and the SeqCA-MS-ResNeXt model achieved an F1 metric of 77.82% using log Mel-spectrogram features with reduced computational complexity.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A neural architecture search technique targeting adversarial attack resiliency for edge AI applications

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11564-9 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

In this work, a Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework is designed that balances the tradeoff between adversarial resiliency, generalization performance, and resource constraints. Two types of defense mechanisms (Type-I and Type-II) have been incorporated into the proposed NAS framework and compared elaborately to ensure resilience. Type-I involves employing controlled regularization in the Bayesian optimization search strategy to optimize robustness through solving a black box optimization problem. Whereas, Type-II involves employing controlled non-linear stochasticity into the deep learning architectures through injecting Gaussian noise at the time of training, which optimizes robustness by disrupting deterministic computational pathways that are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. However, optimization of computational resources is done by implementing fully trained, robust, and well-generalized models on commercially available resource-constrained (Edge AI) platforms, preserving the said performances. For validating the proposed framework, three image classification datasets (MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100) have been investigated, where three different types of adversarial attacks (FGSM, PGD, and BIM) have been harnessed with varying degrees of severity. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves robustness, performance generalization, and throughput, where the Type-II defense strategy outperforms the Type-I and other state-of-the-art methods. Using Type-II defense, following the implementation of adversarially robust and well-generalized models with Deep Learning Processor Unit (DPU), we achieved an average robustness of 82.83%, 54.13%, and 36.68% on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR 100, respectively, a two-fold reduction in latency (cycles) targeting ZCU104 FPGA board. Whereas, the throughput in terms of frames per second (FPS) ranges from 984.31 to 2971.16. Furthermore, it is observed that the proposed method also improves the clean accuracy compared to state-of-the-art models. Codes and subsequent files are available at https://github.com/Abhiiishekyadav/Augmented-NAS-Paper.

论文题名

MDSA2CNet: a self-attention-based hybrid deep learning model for disease detection in sugarcane and rice crops

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11532-3 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

The timely and reliable identification of plant diseases is essential for sustaining agricultural productivity and reducing yield losses. In this work, we present S2RMCMD (Sugarcane and Rice Multi-Crop Multi-Disease), a unified benchmark dataset developed by merging three publicly available sources—Sugarcane1 Thite, Sugarcane2 Plant Disease Dataset of Assam, and BangladeshiCrops Rice. The resulting dataset contains 17, 134 high-resolution images spanning 20 disease classes and includes major fungal, bacterial, and viral infections such as red rot, smut, ring spot, grassy shoot, bacterial blight, and rice blast. Images were collected under varied illumination and field conditions, increasing the practical relevance of the dataset for real-world agricultural scenarios. To demonstrate the applicability of S2RMCMD, we introduce MDSA2CNet, a hybrid deep learning architecture that combines MobileNetV2 with three DenseNet variants (DenseNet121, DenseNet169, and DenseNet201) using feature-level concatenation enhanced by a self-attention module. The models were trained using transfer learning with fine-tuning and systematically tuned hyperparameters to achieve optimal performance. A cross-validation approach was employed to assess the model’s robustness across different crop types and disease variations. Experimental evaluations indicate that MDSA2CNet consistently surpasses the individual backbone networks, achieving a training accuracy of 98.38%, test accuracy of 95.29%, precision of 95%, recall of 94%, and an F₁-score of 95%. The principal contribution of this study lies in the creation of the first multi-crop, multi-disease dataset that jointly incorporates sugarcane and rice leaf images, along with a strong hybrid architecture augmented with self-attention that generalizes effectively across diverse disease patterns. This integration demonstrates the potential of cross-crop datasets and attention-based hybrid networks to advance scalable and automated plant disease diagnosis within precision agriculture.

Accurate and robust fault diagnosis of rotary machines is essential for maintaining the safety and reliability of industrial systems. Although deep learning methods have achieved remarkable success in this domain, their performance tends to decline in the presence of noise. In this study, a functional deep learning framework is introduced, in which raw vibration signals are transformed into smooth functional representations prior to being processed by deep learning architectures. By incorporating functional data analysis, the noise robustness and generalization ability of standard models are enhanced. Functional adaptations of several well-established one-dimensional convolutional networks are implemented and evaluated on a benchmark dataset under varying signal-to-noise ratios. The experimental results demonstrate that functional representations consistently improve diagnostic accuracy, particularly in low-SNR environments. These findings underscore the effectiveness of functional techniques in enhancing deep learning-based fault diagnosis of rotary machines operating under noisy conditions.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Investigation of cardinality classification for bacterial colony counting using explainable artificial intelligence

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11483-9 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Automatic bacterial colony counting is a highly sought-after technology in modern biological laboratories because it eliminates manual counting effort. Previous work has observed that MicrobiaNet, currently the best-performing cardinality classification model for colony counting, has difficulty distinguishing colonies of three or more individuals. However, it is unclear if this is due to properties of the data together with inherent characteristics of the MicrobiaNet model. By analysing MicrobiaNet with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), we demonstrate that XAI can provide insights into how data properties constrain cardinality classification performance in colony counting. Our results show that high visual similarity across classes is the key issue hindering further performance improvement, revising prior assertions about MicrobiaNet. These findings suggest future work should focus on models that explicitly incorporate visual similarity or explore density estimation approaches, with broader implications for neural network classifiers trained on imbalanced datasets.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

State-adversarial neuro-dynamic nonlinear PI^λ D^μ control

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11581-8 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Optimization and reinforcement-based algorithms that self-tune fractional order controllers have gained attention in recent years. The proof of stability of fractional order proportional-integral-derivative(PID) controllers usually limits the fractional orders of |μ| and |λ| to between N−1 and N,N∈Z. However, this bound may be too restrictive owing to the loss of closed-loop performance and issues in training deep-learning networks that tune these strategies. In this study, a novel state-adversarial deep deterministic policy gradient nonlinear-fractional order PID (SA-DDPG-NFoPID) controller is constructed. We propose a framework for improper/proper fractional orders of μ and λ with relaxed bounds and sufficient conditions that guarantee stability under undisturbed scenarios in the sense of Lyapunov and separately is guaranteed to be Mittag-Leffler stable under disturbed conditions. The proposed technique is tested with three scenarios including a low-inertia microgrid with high penetration of renewables. The SA-DDPG-NFoPID controller exhibited the best performance in all test scenarios compared to recent control algorithms.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Long-term traffic volume prediction with a self-tuning attention-based model

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11485-7 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Intelligent transportation system (ITS) plays an important role in many smart city applications. Traffic flow forecasting applications form the backbone of intelligent transportation systems. However, the stochastic nature of the traffic flow prevents the desired success from the prediction models. In recent years, traffic data has increased considerably with the developing technologies. However, shallow architectures no longer work for analyzing this big data and drawing consistent results. Therefore, in this study, we propose an attention-based deep ensemble learning model, taking into account the dynamic and chaotic nature of traffic information. Our proposed model appropriately combines deep learning models of different architectures based on their single prediction performance. We use an attention-based deep learning model to evaluate the success of individual models. Thus, we give more weight to more successful models and reduce the weights of less successful models. The model provides adaptive predictions, allowing updates based on traffic fluctuations. Experiments show that our attention-based deep ensemble model is more successful than various traffic prediction models.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Enhanced image classification using a stacked ResNet-based attention network with weighted multi-scale CBAM

期刊：Soft Computing · DOI：10.1007/s00500-026-11530-5 · 摘要来源：已核验来源

Image classification, a pivotal task in computer vision, demands robust feature representation. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) excel in this domain, but their performance is strongly affected by network architecture and can be strengthened by attention mechanisms. However, their performance can plateau with increasing depth and width and most existing attention mechanisms have limitations in flexibly weighting different pooling descriptors and capturing multi-scale spatial information. To overcome these limitations, this study proposes a Stacked ResNet-based Attention Network (SRANet) with Weighted Multi-Scale CBAM to improve feature representation capabilities. It is stacked with multiple Channel-adjustable Residual Modules (CARMs) and Weighted Multi-Scale Convolutional Block Attention Modules (WMSCBAMs). By mandatorily increasing output channels in convolutional layers and employing weighted channel and multi-scale spatial attention, SRANet achieves outstanding classification accuracy. Experimental results on CIFAR and STL-10 datasets demonstrate SRANet’s superior performance, balancing accuracy with resource efficiency. Here, we show a 96.27% and 79.89% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, respectively, and an 89.54% accuracy on STL-10, outperforming existing models.
